## Before submitting

- [x] I agree to license this contribution under [LICENSE.txt](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/LICENSE.txt).
- [x] I ran scoped pre-commit checks and reviewed the applicable Hard Rules.
- [x] I added category, area and origin labels.

## Summary

Add opt-in FROST engine **20609** for d128 SDPA backward through the existing cuDNN Frontend graph API. Dense MHA supports BF16/FP16, unmasked and top-left causal attention. Exact SM100 also supports packed THD MHA and BF16 dense/THD GQA/MQA.

The main kernel computes all five attention products, using FP32 atomic dQ scratch and a final cast. Grouped attention stores BF16 per-query-head dK/dV partials and reduces them in FP32. Complete execution takes three to five launches including helpers. Dense MHA retains a one-launch, zero-workspace recompute fallback. Operand placement follows cuDNN's pipeline; no FlashAttention kernel code was copied.

Includes prepared/native bindings, declaration and workspace validation, critical numerical/replay/eligibility tests, and [API documentation](https://github.com/RomanAnders90/cudnn-frontend/blob/frost/codex-b200-bwd-d128/docs/fe-oss-apis/attention/sdpa_bwd_sm100_d128.md). All four accumulation routes use portable 512-column TMEM allocation/deallocation, which compiles with public CuTeDSL 4.8's default CUDA 12 flavor. Grouped dense declarations reject Stats/Delta spans exceeding the signed Int32 index range.

## Selected backward performance

**A2A-derived local BPROP shapes; communication excluded.** The motivating [TransformerEngine report](https://github.com/sudhakarsingh27/TransformerEngine/blob/5d4673da00226be3772cdb135db4cdd0e7b8edeb/benchmarks/attention/README.md) measures distributed forward plus backward with P2P, all-gather or all-to-all. CP2/4 here identifies A2A local-head mapping. These backward-only timings exclude communication and do not establish distributed endpoint speed-ups.

GB200, cc 10.0, 152 SMs, BF16 d128 packed causal GQA; total tokens 524288. CP2 has Hq/Hkv=16/4 and CP4 has 8/2. Latencies include each provider's complete backward chain and exclude the common cuDNN forward. cuDNN is 9.27.0.21; FA4 is 4.0.0b35 at `1fc0221183e799363001394a12dd9e78e15f5dda`, using its default nondeterministic two-CTA backward path. These measurements use the CUDA 13 compiler flavor and predate the portable TMEM change.

| Shape | Baseline (ms) | FROST (ms) | Speed-up | MMA SOL |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| CP2 / 16K | cuDNN 87.696 | 77.817 | +12.68% | unavailable |
| CP2 / 16K | FA4 72.942 | 77.906 | -6.38% | unavailable |
| CP4 / 16K | cuDNN 44.048 | 40.110 | +9.86% | unavailable |
| CP4 / 16K | FA4 37.752 | 40.089 | -5.72% | unavailable |

Each comparison uses a separate A/A control and three A/B/A plus B/A/B rounds, 64 warmups and 100 timed replays per slot. Latencies are medians of bracket values; speed-up is the median paired `100*(baseline/FROST-1)`. Requested clock is 1830 MHz; observed clocks vary under the 1200 W power cap. These selected rows passed timing diagnostics. No calibrated effective-clock MMA roofline was measured.

All 18 packed comparisons completed; 8 other rows had timing drift or insufficient clock samples and were retained as observations rather than stable claims. Earlier dense B=2/H=8 measurements at S=2K–16K reached cuDNN parity and the FA4 3% target for causal attention; unmasked 8K/16K remain outside that target. The separate protocols are not pooled.

The final TMEM portability comparison uses the same CUDA 13.4 compiler for both versions, with each before/after pair run on the same GPU using the A/A and A/B/A–B/A/B controls described above. These are separate measurements; absolute latencies should not be compared across the two tables. All three pairs passed timing diagnostics; the changes are smaller than their measured noise floors (0.286%, 0.418%, and 0.931%, respectively). No performance change was detected. Public CUDA 12 correctness is validated separately below.

| Shape | Before fix (ms) | FROST after fix (ms) | Speed-up | MMA SOL |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| Dense unmasked B=2/H=8, 8K | 1.198104 | 1.197871 | +0.025% | unavailable |
| Dense unmasked B=2/H=8, 16K | 4.600475 | 4.599887 | +0.007% | unavailable |
| THD causal GQA CP2 / 16K | 79.281620 | 79.306382 | -0.077% | unavailable |

These timings include the complete three- or five-kernel backward chain. The 1200 W power limit was active; median busy clocks were approximately 1447–1455, 1440, and 1357 MHz for the three rows.

## Compatibility and validation

Existing engine IDs and public signatures are preserved. Packed/grouped paths require cc 10.0, CuTeDSL >=4.8 and positive FP32-representable scale. Packed MHA supports BF16/FP16; grouped paths support BF16 only. Grouped FP16, deterministic execution, bottom-right/sliding-window masks, bias, sinks, dropout, dense per-batch padding and dense grouped tails decline explicitly. dQ accumulation is nondeterministic; BF16 dK/dV partials introduce intermediate rounding. Caller-owned workspace is initialized on every execution.

Current host validation: **711 passed, zero failures or skips; 78 GPU cases explicitly deselected**. This includes graph and standalone acceptance/rejection around the grouped dense Stats/Delta Int32 boundary. The d128-specific modules now collect 212 cases, reduced from 466 before consolidation; all 302 pre-existing native architecture cases remain.

Public CuTeDSL 4.8 CUDA 12 compilation: the original dense route reproduces the unsupported `.exclusive` error; all four corrected accumulation routes and the unchanged recompute control compile. Accumulation mains have zero spills and retain packed FP32 arithmetic. THD setup helpers have existing compiler-dependent spills, so this is not a claim that every helper is spill-free.

Fresh GB200 execution with public CuTeDSL 4.8 / CUDA 12: **39 passed, zero failures or skips** (9 dense, 13 THD MHA, 17 grouped). This covers all four accumulation routes and the unchanged recompute control, including capture/rebinding, persistent reuse, empty sequences, opposing partials, and allocation/launch checks. Actual compiler imports and returned kernel images were verified; every worker exited and was reaped successfully.

Retained tests cover dense/THD MHA and GQA/MQA numerics, tails and empty sequences, independent origins and gaps, capture/rebinding, no execution-time allocation or host metadata reads, native argument/storage contracts, and unsafe geometry/dtype/compiler declines. Numerical tolerances are unchanged. Scoped pre-commit and whitespace checks pass. Reports, charts, generated data and plotting code are excluded from the source change.

## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **New Features**
  * Added an opt-in SDPA backward engine for 128-dimensional attention on supported SM100-series GPUs, covering dense and packed MHA, GQA, and MQA inputs where supported.
  * Added FP16 and BF16 support in eligible configurations, with automatic implementation selection and fallback.
  * Added support for zero-workspace plans without requiring an aligned workspace buffer.
  * Added support for prepared execution, input rebinding, and CUDA graph capture in supported configurations.
* **Documentation**
  * Documented engine eligibility, input requirements, constraints, workspace behavior, and implementation selection.

**Codex bot review · model: `gpt-6-astra`**

Reviewed `333278627eb2` against base `b4d3184575c1`.

The opt-in engine and prepared-execution structure make sense, but one reproduced compiler-compatibility issue blocks approval: all four accumulation routes fail to compile in an SM100 environment admitted by the DSL >=4.8 gate. The recompute fallback passes. Please fix this before merging; the diagnostic results below isolate a small change that restores these paths.

**[P1 · blocks approval] Do not unconditionally require the newer TMEM .exclusive modifier** ([source](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/333278627eb2ccffc5f47da26d733f87a2d0a8aa/python/cudnn/sdpa/bwd/kernels/sm100/bprop_d128_accum_f16.py#L661))

The is_exclusive=True allocation/deallocation emits a PTX modifier that the available assembler need not support even when public CuTe DSL 4.8.0 and SM100 satisfy the engine's admission checks. On the exact PR head, dense MHA, THD MHA, dense GQA and THD GQA each fail during compilation with `Unknown modifier '.exclusive'`; the dense recompute control passes. The same unguarded arguments occur in bprop_d128_accum_thd_f16.py and both allocation sites in bprop_d128_accum_grouped_f16.py. These kernels allocate 512 columns, so a normal allocation is sufficient. Removing only these eight is_exclusive=True arguments in a separate diagnostic copy makes all four previously failing cases pass. Please use the portable allocation form, or gate the actual compiler capability if exclusivity is necessary. A DSL-version check alone does not establish assembler support. This is a high-risk P1 because normal execution of every new accumulation route fails before launch.

Evidence: Exact-head SM100/public DSL 4.8: test_accumulation_matches_fp64[128-128-dense-bf16], test_thd_mha_graph_smoke, test_grouped_matrix[dense-none-bf16-gqa2], and test_grouped_thd_standalone_smoke[bf16] all fail on the modifier; test_graph_matches_fp64[65-129-dense-bf16] passes. Diagnostic flag removal: 4/4 pass, plus 24 capture/rebinding, persistent reuse, empty-input and opposing-partial cases pass. Attribution: Introduced by the new accumulation templates in this PR; independently reproduced using a freshly built extension and imports pinned to the reviewed source.

Validation: Built the Python native extension from this head and verified the imported source and zero-workspace binder capability. 240 host-side dense/grouped/THD admission and statistics-span tests passed. Exact-head native SM100 execution: four accumulation compilation failures and one passing recompute control, as detailed in the finding. Separate diagnostic copy with only the eight exclusive flags removed: all four failing routes pass; another 24 capture/rebinding, persistent reuse, empty-input and opposing-partial tests pass. These are diagnostic results, not passing results for the unmodified PR.

Limitations: No independent performance claim: the unmodified accumulation kernels do not compile in this environment. Did not independently reproduce the existing CodeRabbit report about very large grouped statistics spans; that is separate from the compiler failure above. CI was not newly triggered while this approval-blocking compilation issue remains. Existing labels, project and milestone are already appropriate.

I am withholding approval for the high-risk P1 findings above and leaving a COMMENT. Please address them before merging.

+    if batch * skv * kv_heads * 16 > 2**31 - 1:
+        raise ValueError("dense KV reduction exceeds the Int32 vector index range")
+    if max(sq, skv) * heads * 128 * 2 >= 2**40:
+        raise ValueError("native BSHD byte stride exceeds the tensor-map stride range")
+    if sq * heads * 128 * 4 >= 2**40:
+        raise ValueError("FP32 dQ byte stride exceeds the tensor-map stride range")

detail.body:
## Before submitting

- [x] I agree to license this contribution under [LICENSE.txt](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/LICENSE.txt).
- [x] I ran scoped pre-commit checks and reviewed the applicable Hard Rules.
- [x] I added category, area and origin labels.

## Summary

Add opt-in FROST engine **20609** for d128 SDPA backward through the existing cuDNN Frontend graph API. Dense MHA supports BF16/FP16, unmasked and top-left causal attention. Exact SM100 also supports packed THD MHA and BF16 dense/THD GQA/MQA.

The main kernel computes all five attention products, using FP32 atomic dQ scratch and a final cast. Grouped attention stores BF16 per-query-head dK/dV partials and reduces them in FP32. Complete execution takes three to five launches including helpers. Dense MHA retains a one-launch, zero-workspace recompute fallback. Operand placement follows cuDNN's pipeline; no FlashAttention kernel code was copied.

Includes prepared/native bindings, declaration and workspace validation, critical numerical/replay/eligibility tests, and [API documentation](https://github.com/RomanAnders90/cudnn-frontend/blob/frost/codex-b200-bwd-d128/docs/fe-oss-apis/attention/sdpa_bwd_sm100_d128.md). All four accumulation routes use portable 512-column TMEM allocation/deallocation, which compiles with public CuTeDSL 4.8's default CUDA 12 flavor. Grouped dense declarations reject Stats/Delta spans exceeding the signed Int32 index range.

## Selected backward performance

**A2A-derived local BPROP shapes; communication excluded.** The motivating [TransformerEngine report](https://github.com/sudhakarsingh27/TransformerEngine/blob/5d4673da00226be3772cdb135db4cdd0e7b8edeb/benchmarks/attention/README.md) measures distributed forward plus backward with P2P, all-gather or all-to-all. CP2/4 here identifies A2A local-head mapping. These backward-only timings exclude communication and do not establish distributed endpoint speed-ups.

GB200, cc 10.0, 152 SMs, BF16 d128 packed causal GQA; total tokens 524288. CP2 has Hq/Hkv=16/4 and CP4 has 8/2. Latencies include each provider's complete backward chain and exclude the common cuDNN forward. cuDNN is 9.27.0.21; FA4 is 4.0.0b35 at `1fc0221183e799363001394a12dd9e78e15f5dda`, using its default nondeterministic two-CTA backward path. These measurements use the CUDA 13 compiler flavor and predate the portable TMEM change.

| Shape | Baseline (ms) | FROST (ms) | Speed-up | MMA SOL |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| CP2 / 16K | cuDNN 87.696 | 77.817 | +12.68% | unavailable |
| CP2 / 16K | FA4 72.942 | 77.906 | -6.38% | unavailable |
| CP4 / 16K | cuDNN 44.048 | 40.110 | +9.86% | unavailable |
| CP4 / 16K | FA4 37.752 | 40.089 | -5.72% | unavailable |

Each comparison uses a separate A/A control and three A/B/A plus B/A/B rounds, 64 warmups and 100 timed replays per slot. Latencies are medians of bracket values; speed-up is the median paired `100*(baseline/FROST-1)`. Requested clock is 1830 MHz; observed clocks vary under the 1200 W power cap. These selected rows passed timing diagnostics. No calibrated effective-clock MMA roofline was measured.

All 18 packed comparisons completed; 8 other rows had timing drift or insufficient clock samples and were retained as observations rather than stable claims. Earlier dense B=2/H=8 measurements at S=2K–16K reached cuDNN parity and the FA4 3% target for causal attention; unmasked 8K/16K remain outside that target. The separate protocols are not pooled.

The final TMEM portability comparison uses the same CUDA 13.4 compiler for both versions, with each before/after pair run on the same GPU using the A/A and A/B/A–B/A/B controls described above. These are separate measurements; absolute latencies should not be compared across the two tables. All three pairs passed timing diagnostics; the changes are smaller than their measured noise floors (0.286%, 0.418%, and 0.931%, respectively). No performance change was detected. Public CUDA 12 correctness is validated separately below.

| Shape | Before fix (ms) | FROST after fix (ms) | Speed-up | MMA SOL |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| Dense unmasked B=2/H=8, 8K | 1.198104 | 1.197871 | +0.025% | unavailable |
| Dense unmasked B=2/H=8, 16K | 4.600475 | 4.599887 | +0.007% | unavailable |
| THD causal GQA CP2 / 16K | 79.281620 | 79.306382 | -0.077% | unavailable |

These timings include the complete three- or five-kernel backward chain. The 1200 W power limit was active; median busy clocks were approximately 1447–1455, 1440, and 1357 MHz for the three rows.

## Compatibility and validation

Existing engine IDs and public signatures are preserved. Packed/grouped paths require cc 10.0, CuTeDSL >=4.8 and positive FP32-representable scale. Packed MHA supports BF16/FP16; grouped paths support BF16 only. Grouped FP16, deterministic execution, bottom-right/sliding-window masks, bias, sinks, dropout, dense per-batch padding and dense grouped tails decline explicitly. dQ accumulation is nondeterministic; BF16 dK/dV partials introduce intermediate rounding. Caller-owned workspace is initialized on every execution.

Current host validation: **711 passed, zero failures or skips; 78 GPU cases explicitly deselected**. This includes graph and standalone acceptance/rejection around the grouped dense Stats/Delta Int32 boundary. The d128-specific modules now collect 212 cases, reduced from 466 before consolidation; all 302 pre-existing native architecture cases remain.

Public CuTeDSL 4.8 CUDA 12 compilation: the original dense route reproduces the unsupported `.exclusive` error; all four corrected accumulation routes and the unchanged recompute control compile. Accumulation mains have zero spills and retain packed FP32 arithmetic. THD setup helpers have existing compiler-dependent spills, so this is not a claim that every helper is spill-free.

Fresh GB200 execution with public CuTeDSL 4.8 / CUDA 12: **39 passed, zero failures or skips** (9 dense, 13 THD MHA, 17 grouped). This covers all four accumulation routes and the unchanged recompute control, including capture/rebinding, persistent reuse, empty sequences, opposing partials, and allocation/launch checks. Actual compiler imports and returned kernel images were verified; every worker exited and was reaped successfully.

Retained tests cover dense/THD MHA and GQA/MQA numerics, tails and empty sequences, independent origins and gaps, capture/rebinding, no execution-time allocation or host metadata reads, native argument/storage contracts, and unsafe geometry/dtype/compiler declines. Numerical tolerances are unchanged. Scoped pre-commit and whitespace checks pass. Reports, charts, generated data and plotting code are excluded from the source change.

+# SDPA backward, d = 128 (SM100)
+
+The opt-in `sdpa_bwd_sm100_d128` engine serves dense multi-head attention with
+BF16 or FP16 inputs and gradients, compact BSHD physical storage, and
+contiguous FP32 natural-log Stats. It supports unmasked and top-left causal
+attention, including rectangular query and key/value lengths. Packed THD MHA
+supports both dtypes. Dense and THD GQA/MQA initially support BF16 only. Packed
+and grouped paths require exact SM100 (cc 10.0), CuTeDSL 4.8 or newer and
+positive FP32 attention scale. Grouped dense lengths must be multiples of 128;
+packed grouped lengths may have tails or empty actual sequences. Other masks,
+bias, sinks, dropout and deterministic requests are declined.
+
+Use the ordinary cuDNN graph preparation and execution API. After building
+and selecting a plan, allocate the size reported by that plan:
+
+```python
+workspace = torch.empty(graph.get_workspace_size(), dtype=torch.uint8, device=q.device)
+graph.execute(variant_pack, workspace)
+```
+
+Plan construction selects the implementation from declarations and the build
+device. On SM100 with public CuTeDSL 4.8 or newer, positive attention scale and
+both sequence lengths divisible by 128, the MHA three-kernel chain computes the row
+delta while initializing FP32 dQ scratch, accumulates dQ and writes dK/dV,
+then converts dQ to the output type. The output conversion applies no extra
+scale. Its scratch size is `4 * B * H * S_q * 129 + 240` bytes. The final 240
+bytes cover internal alignment for any valid 16-byte-aligned caller workspace.
+
+Other dense MHA declarations in the existing envelope, including sequence tails and
+negative finite nonzero scales, retain the one-kernel implementation with
+zero workspace. Always query the plan's size rather than assuming either
+implementation. Zero and nonfinite scales are unsupported.
+
+Dense MHA declarations are bounded before either implementation is selected:
+`max(S_q,S_kv) <= 2**31-128`, `B*H*S_q <= 2**31-1`,
+`B*H*(ceil(S_q/128)+ceil(S_kv/128)) <= 2**31-1`, and
+`max(S_q,S_kv)*H*128*2 < 2**40`. These conservative limits keep tile rounding,
+Stats indexing, the recompute launch grid and tensor-map byte strides
+representable. Exceeding a limit declines the engine before compilation.
+
+The accumulation implementation requires both attention scale and its product
+with log2(e) to remain finite and positive in FP32. A scalar override on an
+already compiled accumulation plan must satisfy that requirement. Invalid
+overrides raise before any kernel launches; they do not change the plan.
+
+Inputs, outputs and workspace must remain on the declared CUDA device.
+Gradient outputs must not overlap each other or any input, and workspace
+must not overlap any operand. Execution binds the current buffers and stream,
+initializes its scratch each time, and performs no allocation, layout copy or
+device-to-host read. The plan supports CUDA-graph capture and replay. FP32 dQ
+atomic accumulation does not promise bitwise repeatability.
+
+The three-kernel implementation is selected only on SM100. Existing support
+on other pre-Rubin Blackwell devices retains the previous implementation.
+The engine remains opt-in while performance qualification proceeds.
+
+For packed THD, declare positive `max_total_seq_len_q` and
+`max_total_seq_len_kv` capacities and device sequence lengths. Each port's
+ragged offsets retain their declared origins, including nonzero initial
+offsets and gaps. Packed rows require compact head/token strides; the logical
+batch stride is unused. FP32 Stats may be packed token-major `(T,H)` or
+head-major `(1,H,head_stride)`, with the latter covering the physical query
+capacity. Actual sequences may be empty, and lengths need not divide 128.
+
+The packed MHA plan launches metadata/tensor-map setup, Delta plus dQ
+initialization, the backward main kernel, then dQ conversion. Its caller
+workspace holds FP32 dQ and Delta, sequence metadata, per-port origins and
+seven tensor maps per batch; it has no dK/dV workspace. Query the plan's
+workspace size. Execution reads lengths and offsets on the device and
+performs no allocation, tensor conversion or host read of metadata. Gradient
+outputs and workspace must also be disjoint from all metadata operands.
+Declared capacities must be positive even when every actual sequence is
+empty. This path requires exact cc 10.0 and both scale and scale*log2(e)
+finite and positive in FP32.
+
+GQA/MQA requires `Hq > Hkv > 0` and an integral `Hq/Hkv`; ratios need not
+be powers of two. Each query head uses KV head `q_head // (Hq/Hkv)` and writes
+its own BF16 dK/dV partials. A final kernel sums them in fixed query-head order using FP32
+and converts to the native gradient dtype. Thus partial storage rounds each
+query head's contribution before the group fold. Regular correctness tests
+retain the same numerical tolerances as MHA.
+
+Grouped plans append two caller-workspace regions: dense
+`[B,Skv,Hq,128]` or packed `[1,round128(Tkv_compact),Hq,128]`, each at two
+bytes per element. Packed partials use compact KV prefixes; the final fold
+writes each dK/dV port at its independent declared origin. Dense grouped
+execution has four launches; packed grouped execution has five. Their dQ
+scratch, device metadata, alias checks, rebinding and capture contract match
+the corresponding MHA plan. Always query workspace size from the plan.
+
+Grouped support and packed support do not imply performance parity with
+another backend; that qualification is a separate step.
+
+FP16 grouped attention is declined because per-query-head partials can overflow
+FP16 before cancellation in the final group sum. Wider partial storage is
+required before enabling that path. FP16 dense and packed MHA remain supported.

+        require(self.q_desc.device.type == "cuda", "Q must reside on CUDA")
+        cc = compute_capability(resolve_device(self.q_desc.device))
+        require(100 <= cc[0] * 10 + cc[1] <= 106, f"requires SM100-106; got {cc}")
+        arch_error = cutedsl_arch_requirement_error(cc)
+        require(arch_error is None, arch_error)
+        binder = getattr(_pybind_module, "_SdpaBwdBinder", None)
+        require(getattr(binder, "supports_zero_workspace", False), "requires a frontend extension with zero-workspace backward binding support")
+        require(not self.thd, "THD / ragged is not supported")
+        require(not self.seq_q_lens_present and not self.seq_kv_lens_present, "padding masks are not supported")
+        require(not self.causal_bottom_right, "bottom-right causal is not supported")
+        require(self.window_size_left is None and self.window_size_right is None, "sliding windows and right-band widening are not supported")
+        require(not self.deterministic, "use_deterministic_algorithm is not claimed")
+        require(all(d is None for d in (self.sink_desc, self.dsink_desc, self.bias_desc, self.dbias_desc)), "sink / dSink and bias / dBias are not supported")
+        require(self.tile_m is None and self.tile_n is None, "the kernel has fixed tile geometry")
+        for role in ROLES[:9]:
+            desc = getattr(self, role + "_desc")
+            require(desc.ndim == 4 and all(int(n) > 0 for n in desc.shape), f"{role} requires positive rank-four dimensions")
+            require(desc.device == self.q_desc.device, f"{role} must reside on {self.q_desc.device}")

+        bk, hk, sk, dk = self.k_desc.shape
+        require(d == dk == 128, "D_QK and D_V must equal 128")
+        require(b == bk and h == hk, "Q and KV require equal batch and head counts (dense MHA)")
+        try:
+            validate_dense_bounds(b, h, sq, sk)
+        except ValueError as error:
+            require(False, str(error))
+        self.dtype = self.q_desc.dtype
+        require(self.dtype in (torch.bfloat16, torch.float16), "only BF16 and FP16 are supported")
+        for role in ROLES[:9]:
+            desc = getattr(self, role + "_desc")
+            if role == "stats":
+                require(tuple(desc.shape) == (b, h, sq, 1) and desc.dtype == torch.float32, "Stats must be FP32 (B, H, S_q, 1)")
+                require(desc.is_contiguous(), "Stats must be contiguous")
+            else:
+                s = sk if role in ("k", "v", "dk", "dv") else sq
+                expected = (b, h, s, 128)
+                require(tuple(desc.shape) == expected and desc.dtype == self.dtype, f"{role} must have shape {expected} and Q's dtype")
+                require(_same_geometry((desc.shape, desc.stride), (expected, (s * h * 128, 128, h * 128, 1))), f"{role} must use compact BSHD storage")
+        self.batch_size, self.h_q, self.h_kv = b, h, h
+        self.s_q_max, self.s_k_max = sq, sk
+        self.head_dim_qk = self.head_dim_v = 128
+        self.scale_softmax = 128**-0.5 if self.scale_softmax is None else float(self.scale_softmax)
+        require(math.isfinite(self.scale_softmax) and self.scale_softmax != 0, "attn_scale must be finite and nonzero")
+        self._implementation = select_implementation(cc, version, int(b), int(h), int(sq), int(sk), self.scale_softmax)
+        self._is_supported = True
+        return True
+
+    def compile(self):
+        if self._uses_grouped_heads():
+            from .prepared_sm100_d128_grouped import compile_plan
+
+            self._ensure_support_checked()
+            self._prepared = compile_plan(self)
+            self._compiled_kernel = self._prepared.artifact
+            return
+        if self.thd:
+            from .prepared_sm100_d128_thd import compile_plan
+
+            self._ensure_support_checked()
+            self._prepared = compile_plan(self)
+            self._compiled_kernel = self._prepared.artifact
+            return
+        from .prepared_sm100_d128 import compile_plan
+
+        self._ensure_support_checked()
+        self._prepared = compile_plan(self)
+        self._compiled_kernel = self._prepared.artifact
+
+    def scratch_workspace_bytes(self):
+        self._ensure_support_checked()
+        if self.h_q != self.h_kv:
+            return self._grouped_workspace_bytes
+        if self.thd:
+            return self._thd_workspace_bytes
+        if self._implementation == ACCUMULATION:
+            return workspace_layout(self.batch_size, self.h_q, self.s_q_max)[1]
+        return 0
+
+    def execute(
+        self,
+        q_tensor,
+        k_tensor,
+        v_tensor,
+        o_tensor,
+        do_tensor,
+        stats_tensor,
+        dq_tensor,
+        dk_tensor,
+        dv_tensor,
+        scale_softmax=None,
+        workspace=None,
+        current_stream=None,
+        **optional,
+    ):
+        from cudnn._device import ensure_current_context
+        from cudnn.sdpa.fwd.prepared import facts_of_tensor
+        from .prepared import ROLES, execute
+
+        if self._prepared is None:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"{self._NAME}: compile the plan before execute")
+        if self.thd:
+            from .prepared_sm100_d128_thd import execute_standalone
+
+            execute_standalone(
+                self,
+                (q_tensor, k_tensor, v_tensor, o_tensor, do_tensor, stats_tensor, dq_tensor, dk_tensor, dv_tensor),
+                workspace,
+                current_stream,
+                scale_softmax,
+                optional,
+            )
+            return
+        if any(value is not None for value in optional.values()):
+            raise ValueError(f"{self._NAME}: optional operands were not compiled into this plan")
+        tensors = (q_tensor, k_tensor, v_tensor, o_tensor, do_tensor, stats_tensor, dq_tensor, dk_tensor, dv_tensor)
+        facts = dict(zip(ROLES[:9], map(facts_of_tensor, tensors)))
+        geometry = tuple((getattr(self, role + "_desc").shape, getattr(self, role + "_desc").stride) for role in ROLES[:9])
+        spec = self._prepared
+        workspace_ptr = 0
+        if spec.workspace_bytes:
+            ws = facts_of_tensor(workspace)
+            if ws is None or ws.dtype != "uint8" or not ws.contiguous or ws.span < spec.workspace_bytes or ws.device != (2, spec.device_index):
+                raise ValueError(f"{self._NAME} requires {spec.workspace_bytes} bytes of contiguous uint8 workspace on CUDA device {spec.device_index}")
+            workspace_ptr = ws.ptr
+        stream = int(torch.cuda.current_stream(self.q_desc.device).cuda_stream if current_stream is None else current_stream)
+        context = nullcontext() if torch.cuda.current_device() == spec.device_index else torch.cuda.device(spec.device_index)
+        with context:
+            ensure_current_context(stream, spec.device_index)
+            execute(spec, facts, workspace_ptr, stream, scale=scale_softmax, geometry=geometry)

+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright (c) 2026 NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES. All rights reserved.
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Host-only selection and workspace contract for dense d128 backward."""
+
+import math
+import re
+import struct
+
+ACCUMULATION = "accumulation"
+RECOMPUTE = "recompute"
+WORKSPACE_ALIGNMENT = 256
+WORKSPACE_SLACK = WORKSPACE_ALIGNMENT - 16
+ABI_VERSION = 2
+
+
+def validate_dense_bounds(batch, heads, sq, skv):
+    """Bound dense MHA declarations before either implementation is selected."""
+    if any(type(n) is not int or n <= 0 for n in (batch, heads, sq, skv)):
+        raise ValueError("dense d128 dimensions must be positive integers")
+    # The recompute body uses Int32 sequence coordinates, including the
+    # one-past-tile endpoint and ceil_div(endpoint, 128) in the causal bound.
+    if max(sq, skv) > 2**31 - 128:
+        raise ValueError("dense d128 sequence envelope exceeds safe Int32 tile rounding")
+    # Its one-dimensional grid contains both Q and KV owners. Bounding the
+    # full grid also bounds batch/head coordinates and decoder products.
+    owners = (sq + 127) // 128 + (skv + 127) // 128
+    if batch * heads * owners > 2**31 - 1:
+        raise ValueError("dense d128 launch envelope exceeds the grid or Int32 work-id range")
+    # The recompute Stats coordinates do not explicitly widen before applying
+    # their compact strides; accumulation also uses an Int32 row index.
+    if batch * heads * sq > 2**31 - 1:
+        raise ValueError("dense d128 Stats index exceeds the Int32 range")
+    # Prepared operands normalize singleton pitches to these compact BSHD
+    # strides. Every 16-bit tensor-map byte stride must be strictly below 2**40.
+    if max(sq, skv) * heads * 128 * 2 >= 2**40:
+        raise ValueError("dense d128 BSHD byte stride exceeds the tensor-map stride range")
+
+
+def _float32(value):
+    return struct.unpack("f", struct.pack("f", value))[0]
+
+
+def validate_accumulation_scale(scale):
+    """Check both FP32 scales consumed by the accumulation implementation."""
+    try:
+        if not math.isfinite(scale) or scale <= 0:
+            raise ValueError
+        rounded = _float32(scale)
+        exponent = _float32(rounded * _float32(1.4426950408889634))
+        if not math.isfinite(rounded) or rounded <= 0 or not math.isfinite(exponent) or exponent <= 0:
+            raise ValueError
+    except (TypeError, ValueError, OverflowError, struct.error):
+        raise ValueError("dense d128 accumulation requires scale and scale*log2(e) finite and positive in FP32") from None
+
+
+def select_implementation(cc, dsl_version, batch, heads, sq, skv, scale):
+    """Choose from plan facts, preserving the existing recompute envelope."""
+    if tuple(cc) != (10, 0) or not dsl_version or dsl_version[0] != "nvidia-cutlass-dsl":
+        return RECOMPUTE
+    match = re.match(r"^(\d+)\.(\d+)\.(\d+)", dsl_version[1])
+    if match is None or tuple(map(int, match.groups())) < (4, 8, 0):
+        return RECOMPUTE
+    if any(type(n) is not int or n <= 0 for n in (batch, heads, sq, skv)) or sq % 128 or skv % 128:
+        return RECOMPUTE
+    if max(sq, skv) > 2**31 - 1:
+        return RECOMPUTE
+    if batch > 65535 or heads > 65535 or batch * heads * sq > 2**31 - 1 or batch * heads * (skv // 128) > 2**31 - 1:
+        return RECOMPUTE
+    # The causal scheduler divides Int32 tile ids by swizzle * num_k_tiles.
+    # Use the compiled host's fixed d128, 16-bit L2 grouping for either mask.
+    heads_per_l2 = (50 * 1024 * 1024) // (sq * (128 + 128) * 2)
+    swizzle = 1 << (heads_per_l2.bit_length() - 1) if heads_per_l2 > 0 else 1
+    if swizzle * (skv // 128) > 2**31 - 1:
+        return RECOMPUTE
+    if max(sq, skv) * heads * 128 * 2 >= 2**40:
+        return RECOMPUTE
+    try:
+        validate_accumulation_scale(scale)
+    except ValueError:
+        return RECOMPUTE
+    return ACCUMULATION
+
+
+def workspace_layout(batch, heads, sq):
+    """Return aligned-payload-relative regions and advertised allocation bytes."""
+    if any(type(n) is not int or n <= 0 for n in (batch, heads, sq)):
+        raise ValueError("dense d128 workspace dimensions must be positive integers")
+    rounded = (sq + 127) // 128 * 128
+    dq_bytes = 4 * batch * rounded * heads * 128
+    delta_bytes = 4 * batch * heads * rounded
+    regions = (
+        (0, (batch, rounded, heads, 128), (rounded * heads * 128, heads * 128, 128, 1)),
+        (dq_bytes, (batch, heads, rounded), (heads * rounded, rounded, 1)),
+    )
+    total = dq_bytes + delta_bytes + WORKSPACE_SLACK
+    if total > 2**63 - 1:
+        raise ValueError("dense d128 workspace exceeds the signed pointer range")
+    return regions, total
+
+
+def validate_launch(pointers, spans, workspace, workspace_bytes, scale):
+    """Validate current addresses and scale before any of the three launches."""
+    validate_accumulation_scale(scale)
+    if len(pointers) != 9 or len(spans) != 9:
+        raise ValueError("dense d128 accumulation requires nine bound operands")
+    if workspace <= 0 or workspace % 16 or workspace + workspace_bytes > 2**63 - 1:
+        raise ValueError("dense d128 accumulation needs an aligned caller workspace within the signed pointer range")
+    for i, (ptr, span) in enumerate(zip(pointers, spans)):
+        if ptr <= 0 or span <= 0 or ptr + span > 2**63 - 1:
+            raise ValueError("dense d128 operand exceeds the signed pointer range")
+        if ptr < workspace + workspace_bytes and workspace < ptr + span:
+            raise ValueError("dense d128 caller workspace overlaps an operand")
+        if i >= 6:
+            for j in range(i):
+                if ptr < pointers[j] + spans[j] and pointers[j] < ptr + span:
+                    raise ValueError("dense d128 gradient output overlaps another operand")

+    """Shared declaration-only launch checks for the adapter and row matcher."""
+    if any(type(n) is not int or n <= 0 for n in (batch, heads, kv_heads, sq, skv)):

+    if heads <= kv_heads or heads % kv_heads:

+"""Origin-aware THD fold of compact per-Q-head dK/dV partials.
+
+The shared vector reducer owns accumulation and conversion. This module only
+maps sequence-local live rows to compact scratch and each output's independent
+ragged origin; it adds no architecture-specific instructions or repacking.
+"""
+
+import cutlass
+import cutlass.cute as cute
+
+from cudnn.frost.tile_dsl.thd import thd_port_origin
+from .bprop_chain_common import _reduce_group_vec
+
+REDUCE_THREADS = 256
+REDUCE_VECTOR = 8
+
+
+@cute.kernel
+def dkv_reduce_thd_origins_kernel(
+    dk_part: cute.Tensor,
+    dv_part: cute.Tensor,
+    dk: cute.Tensor,
+    dv: cute.Tensor,
+    meta: cute.Tensor,
+    origins: cute.Tensor,
+    n_batch: cutlass.Int32,
+    dk_origin: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    dv_origin: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    D: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    group: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    io_dtype: cutlass.Constexpr,
+):
+    """Each live 16-byte output vector has one owner; both sums are FP32."""
+    block, batch, kv_head = cute.arch.block_idx()
+    tid = cute.arch.thread_idx()[0]
+    local_vec = cutlass.Int64(block) * REDUCE_THREADS + cutlass.Int64(tid)
+    local_pos = local_vec * REDUCE_VECTOR
+    row = local_pos // D
+    col = local_pos % D
+    data = cutlass.make_array_view(meta)
+    length = cutlass.Int64(data[batch])
+    if row < length:
+        start = cutlass.Int64(data[2 * n_batch + 1 + batch])
+        h_kv = dk.shape[2]
+        h_q = dk_part.shape[2]
+        # The shared reducer decodes a compact logical [local row, KV head, D]
+        # vector. Pointer biases place that vector at each physical output's
+        # own origin and strides while its inputs retain compact KV prefixes.
+        index = ((row * h_kv + cutlass.Int64(kv_head)) * D + col) // REDUCE_VECTOR
+        k_token = thd_port_origin(origins, dk_origin, batch, start)
+        v_token = thd_port_origin(origins, dv_origin, batch, start)
+        k_bias = (
+            k_token * cutlass.Int64(dk.stride[1]) + row * (cutlass.Int64(dk.stride[1]) - h_kv * D) + cutlass.Int64(kv_head) * (cutlass.Int64(dk.stride[2]) - D)
+        )
+        v_bias = (
+            v_token * cutlass.Int64(dv.stride[1]) + row * (cutlass.Int64(dv.stride[1]) - h_kv * D) + cutlass.Int64(kv_head) * (cutlass.Int64(dv.stride[2]) - D)
+        )
+        _reduce_group_vec(
+            dk_part.iterator.raw_ptr() + start * cutlass.Int64(dk_part.stride[1]),
+            dk.iterator.raw_ptr() + k_bias,
+            index,
+            h_kv,
+            h_q,
+            D=D,
+            group=group,
+            io_dtype=io_dtype,
+            wide=True,
+        )
+        _reduce_group_vec(
+            dv_part.iterator.raw_ptr() + start * cutlass.Int64(dv_part.stride[1]),
+            dv.iterator.raw_ptr() + v_bias,
+            index,
+            h_kv,
+            h_q,
+            D=D,
+            group=group,
+            io_dtype=io_dtype,
+            wide=True,
+        )
+
+
+dkv_reduce_thd_origins_kernel.set_name_prefix("cudnn", remove_cutlass_symbol=True)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def dkv_reduce_thd_origins_host(
+    dk_part,
+    dv_part,
+    dk,
+    dv,
+    meta,
+    origins,
+    n_batch,
+    max_skv,
+    dk_origin: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    dv_origin: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    D: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    group: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    io_dtype: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    stream,
+):
+    """One fold launch; device lengths guard every input read and output write.
+
+    Partials are compact [1,T,Hq,D] and outputs [1,Tphys,Hkv,D] with unit
+    feature stride and vector-aligned token/head strides. D is shared by dK
+    and dV and divisible by eight. The output origins may differ independently.
+    """
+    blocks = cute.math.max((cutlass.Int64(max_skv) * (D // REDUCE_VECTOR) + REDUCE_THREADS - 1) // REDUCE_THREADS, cutlass.Int64(1))
+    dkv_reduce_thd_origins_kernel(dk_part, dv_part, dk, dv, meta, origins, n_batch, dk_origin, dv_origin, D, group, io_dtype).launch(
+        grid=(blocks, n_batch, dk.shape[2]), block=(REDUCE_THREADS, 1, 1), stream=stream
+    )

+    dv_full: MBarrier
+    dk_full: MBarrier
+    dvk_empty: MBarrier
+    sched_full: MBarrier
+    sched_empty: MBarrier

+
+def _view(slab, offset, dtype, count, alignment=16):
+    ptr = Pointer(slab.data_ptr() + offset, dtype=dtype)
+    return cutlass.Array(ptr.ir_value(), shape=count, dtype=dtype, alignment=alignment)
+
+
+def _bars(slab):
+    kinds = {"mma": Producer.MMA_COMMIT, "tma": Producer.TMA_LOAD, "thread": Producer.THREAD}
+    return Bars(
+        *(
+            MBarrier(_view(slab, off, cutlass.Int64, slots), stages=slots, init_count=count, producer=kinds[kind], try_wait=True)
+            for _, off, slots, count, kind in BAR_LAYOUT
+        )
+    )

+
+def _operand(slab, offset, dtype, *, transpose=False, fp32=False):
+    box = CFG.DQ_BOX if fp32 else CFG.HEAD_BOX
+    bpe = 4 if fp32 else CFG.BPE
+    return SmemTile(
+        base=_view(slab, offset, dtype, CFG.M * CFG.D, alignment=1024),
+        elems_per_stage=CFG.M * CFG.D,
+        leading_byte_offset=CFG.M * CFG.SWIZZLE_BYTES if transpose else 16,
+        stride_byte_offset=8 * CFG.SWIZZLE_BYTES,
+        layout=CFG.SWIZZLE_LAYOUT,
+        tma_loads_per_tile=CFG.D // box,
+        tma_granu_elems=box,
+        tma_subtile_stride_elems=CFG.M * box,
+        desc_version=CFG.DESC_VERSION,
+    )
+
+
+def _mma_desc(dtype, *, atranspose=False, btranspose=False):
+    return MmaDesc(
+        M=CFG.M,
+        N=CFG.N,
+        K=CFG.D,
+        bpe_a=CFG.BPE,
+        bpe_b=CFG.BPE,
+        tile_k_hw=CFG.K_HW,
+        atranspose=atranspose,
+        btranspose=btranspose,
+        cta_group=1,
+        idesc=nvvm.Tcgen05InstrDesc.build(
+            c_dtype=cutlass.Float32, a_dtype=dtype, b_dtype=dtype, m_dim=CFG.M, n_dim=CFG.N, a_major=int(atranspose), b_major=int(btranspose)
+        ),
+        kind=nvvm.Tcgen05MMAKind.F16,
+    )

+@cute.jit
+def _wait(bar, phase):
+    bar.wait(phase)
+    # All full-warp consumers reconverge before any elected credit/issue.
+    nvvm.bar_warp_sync(cute.arch.FULL_MASK)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _wait_tcgen(bar, phase):
+    _wait(bar, phase)
+    nvvm.tcgen05_fence(nvvm.Tcgen05Fence.AFTER_THREAD_SYNC)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _commit(bar):
+    if nvvm.elect_sync():
+        bar.arrive(cta_group=1)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _credit(bar):
+    if nvvm.elect_sync():
+        bar.arrive()

+
+@cute.jit
+def _tmem_load(address, n: cutlass.Constexpr[int], dtype: cutlass.Constexpr = cutlass.Float32):
+    return nvvm.tcgen05_ld("32x32b", nvvm.make_tmem_ptr(address, dtype), num=n)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _tmem_store(address, values):
+    nvvm.tcgen05_st("32x32b", nvvm.make_tmem_ptr(address, cutlass.Int32), values)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def tma_reduce_subtile(smem_tile, gmem_slice, subtile: cutlass.Constexpr[int]):
+    """One elected source-sized FP32 add; caller owns commit and wait/credit."""
+    desc = gmem_slice.tma_desc.get_ptr()
+    coords = [gmem_slice.coord_d + cutlass.Int32(subtile * smem_tile.tma_granu_elems)] + list(gmem_slice.coords[1:])
+    src = smem_tile.base.subview(subtile * smem_tile.tma_subtile_stride_elems)
+    if nvvm.elect_sync():
+        nvvm.cp_async_bulk_tensor_reduce(desc, src, "add", coords)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _decode_flat(tile, nheads, nk, swizzle: cutlass.Constexpr[int], batch_heads: cutlass.Constexpr[int]):
+    group = tile // (swizzle * nk)
+    inner = tile % (swizzle * nk)
+    block = cutlass.Int32(0)
+    residual = cutlass.Int32(0)
+    if group < batch_heads // swizzle:
+        block = inner // swizzle
+        residual = inner % swizzle
+    else:
+        block = inner // max(batch_heads % swizzle, 1)
+        residual = inner % max(batch_heads % swizzle, 1)
+    hb = group * swizzle + residual
+    return block, hb % nheads, hb // nheads
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _next_tile(sched, bars, state, nheads, nk, causal: cutlass.Constexpr[bool], swizzle: cutlass.Constexpr[int], batch_heads: cutlass.Constexpr[int]):
+    _wait(bars.sched_full[state.idx], state.phase)
+    x, yz, valid = read_clc_payload(sched, state.idx * 8, warp_broadcast=True)
+    if cutlass.const_expr(causal):
+        block, head, batch = _decode_flat(x, nheads, nk, swizzle, batch_heads)
+    else:
+        block = x
+        head = yz & 0xFFFF
+        batch = (yz >> 16) & 0xFFFF
+    return block, head, batch, valid, advance(state, CFG.SCHED_STAGES)
+
+
+def _tensor_map(tensor, box):
+    # Logical TMA coordinates (d, sequence, head, batch), source-proved order.
+    return tmap.create_tensor_map_tiled_from_view(tensor, box_dims=(1, CFG.M, 1, box), stride_order=(3, 1, 2, 0), swizzle=tmap.TensorMapSwizzle.s128b)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _bounds(block, sq, causal: cutlass.Constexpr[bool]):
+    lo = cutlass.Int32(0)
+    if cutlass.const_expr(causal):
+        lo = block
+    return lo, sq // CFG.N
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _stats(slab, lse, delta, row, group, qbase, batch, head, scale):
+    # Every one of256 lanes participates in both named barriers. Each group
+    # writes a different128-float vector, one row per lane.
+    named_barrier_fence(CFG.SOFTMAX_BARRIER, CFG.SOFTMAX_LANES)
+    if group == 0:
+        val = cutlass.Float32(lse[batch, head, qbase + row])
+        stat = -cutlass.Float32(LOG2E) * val
+        if val == cutlass.Float32(float("-inf")):
+            stat = cutlass.Float32(0.0)
+        _view(slab, CFG.STATS, cutlass.Float32, CFG.N).subview(row).store(stat)
+    else:
+        stat = -scale * cutlass.Float32(delta[batch, head, qbase + row])
+        _view(slab, CFG.DELTA, cutlass.Float32, CFG.N).subview(row).store(stat)
+    named_barrier_fence(CFG.SOFTMAX_BARRIER, CFG.SOFTMAX_LANES)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _p_values(slab, tmem_base, row, group, block, qtile, lo, scale, causal: cutlass.Constexpr[bool], dtype: cutlass.Constexpr):
+    address = tmem_base + group * 64
+    a = _tmem_load(address, 32)
+    b = _tmem_load(address + 32, 32)
+    nvvm.tcgen05_wait(kind=nvvm.Tcgen05Wait.LOAD)
+    scores = cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(a[i] for i in range(32)) + tuple(b[i] for i in range(32)), cutlass.Float32)
+    p = []
+    packed = []
+    scaled = scale * cutlass.Float32(LOG2E)
+    for chunk in cutlass.range_constexpr(16):
+        stat = _view(slab, CFG.STATS, cutlass.Float32, CFG.N).subview(group * 64 + chunk * 4).load(vector_size=4, alignment=16)
+        for pair in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+            i = chunk * 4 + pair * 2
+            s0, s1 = scores[i], scores[i + 1]
+            if cutlass.const_expr(causal):
+                if qtile == lo:
+                    kr = block * CFG.M + row
+                    qc = qtile * CFG.N + group * 64 + i
+                    s0 = cutlass.Float32(arith.select((kr <= qc).ir_value(), s0.ir_value(), cutlass.Float32(float("-inf")).ir_value()))
+                    s1 = cutlass.Float32(arith.select((kr <= qc + 1).ir_value(), s1.ir_value(), cutlass.Float32(float("-inf")).ir_value()))
+            e0, e1 = ffma2(scaled, scaled, s0, s1, stat[pair * 2], stat[pair * 2 + 1])
+            p0 = cute.math.exp2(e0, fastmath=True)
+            p1 = cute.math.exp2(e1, fastmath=True)
+            p.extend((p0, p1))
+            packed.append(fp32_to_fp16(p0, p1, dtype=dtype))
+    _tmem_store(address, cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(packed), cutlass.Int32))
+    return cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(p), cutlass.Float32)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _ds_values(slab, tmem_base, group, p, scale, dtype: cutlass.Constexpr):
+    address = tmem_base + 128 + group * 64
+    a = _tmem_load(address, 32)
+    b = _tmem_load(address + 32, 32)
+    nvvm.tcgen05_wait(kind=nvvm.Tcgen05Wait.LOAD)
+    dp = cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(a[i] for i in range(32)) + tuple(b[i] for i in range(32)), cutlass.Float32)
+    packed = []
+    for chunk in cutlass.range_constexpr(16):
+        stat = _view(slab, CFG.DELTA, cutlass.Float32, CFG.N).subview(group * 64 + chunk * 4).load(vector_size=4, alignment=16)
+        for pair in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+            i = chunk * 4 + pair * 2
+            d0, d1 = ffma2(scale, scale, dp[i], dp[i + 1], stat[pair * 2], stat[pair * 2 + 1])
+            d0, d1 = fmul2(d0, d1, p[i], p[i + 1])
+            packed.append(fp32_to_fp16(d0, d1, dtype=dtype))
+    _tmem_store(address, cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(packed), cutlass.Int32))
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _softmax_loop(
+    slab,
+    bars,
+    sched,
+    tmem_base,
+    lse,
+    delta,
+    block,
+    head,
+    batch,
+    sq,
+    nk,
+    nheads,
+    batch_heads: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    swizzle: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    scale,
+    causal: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+    dtype: cutlass.Constexpr,
+):
+    nvvm.setmaxregister(CFG.SOFTMAX_REGS, nvvm.SetMaxRegisterAction.INCREASE)
+    tid = cute.arch.thread_idx()[0]
+    row = tid % CFG.M
+    group = tid // CFG.M
+    state = PipelineState.start()
+    sched_state = PipelineState.start()
+    valid = cutlass.Int32(1)
+    while valid != 0:
+        if cutlass.const_expr(not causal):
+            _credit(bars.sched_empty[sched_state.idx])
+        lo, hi = _bounds(block, sq, causal)
+        if lo < hi:
+            _stats(slab, lse, delta, row, group, lo * CFG.N, batch, head, scale)
+        for qtile in cutlass.range(lo, hi, 1, unroll=1):
+            _wait_tcgen(bars.s_done, state.phase)
+            p = _p_values(slab, tmem_base, row, group, block, qtile, lo, scale, causal, dtype)
+            nvvm.tcgen05_wait(kind=nvvm.Tcgen05Wait.STORE)
+            nvvm.tcgen05_fence(nvvm.Tcgen05Fence.BEFORE_THREAD_SYNC)
+            bars.p_ready.arrive()
+            _wait_tcgen(bars.dp_done, state.phase)
+            _ds_values(slab, tmem_base, group, p, scale, dtype)
+            nvvm.tcgen05_wait(kind=nvvm.Tcgen05Wait.STORE)
+            nvvm.tcgen05_fence(nvvm.Tcgen05Fence.BEFORE_THREAD_SYNC)
+            bars.ds_ready.arrive()
+            if qtile + 1 < hi:
+                _stats(slab, lse, delta, row, group, (qtile + 1) * CFG.N, batch, head, scale)
+            state = advance(state, 1)
+        if cutlass.const_expr(causal):
+            _credit(bars.sched_empty[sched_state.idx])
+        block, head, batch, valid, sched_state = _next_tile(sched, bars, sched_state, nheads, nk, causal, swizzle, batch_heads)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _store_words(slab, byte_offset, row, words):
+    for vec in cutlass.range_constexpr(8):
+        off = byte_offset + row * CFG.SWIZZLE_BYTES + ((row % 8) ^ vec) * 16
+        values = cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(words[vec * 4 + k] for k in range(4)), cutlass.Int32)
+        Pointer(slab.data_ptr() + off, dtype=cutlass.Int32).store(values, alignment=16)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _store_dq_slice(slab, row, values, index: cutlass.Constexpr[int]):
+    for vec in cutlass.range_constexpr(8):
+        off = CFG.ALIAS + index * CFG.SLICE_BYTES + row * CFG.SWIZZLE_BYTES + ((row % 8) ^ vec) * 16
+        v = cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(values[index * 32 + vec * 4 + k] for k in range(4)), cutlass.Float32)
+        Pointer(slab.data_ptr() + off, dtype=cutlass.Float32).store(v, alignment=16)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _native_epilogue(slab, tmem_base, bars, row, live, empty_phase, dtype: cutlass.Constexpr, dk: cutlass.Constexpr[bool]):
+    plane = 384 if cutlass.const_expr(dk) else 256
+    base = CFG.ALIAS + (CFG.OPERAND_BYTES if cutlass.const_expr(dk) else 0)
+    last_slice = 3 if cutlass.const_expr(dk) else 1
+    for half in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+        vals = cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(cutlass.Float32(0.0) for _ in range(64)), cutlass.Float32)
+        if live:
+            vals = _tmem_load(tmem_base + plane + half * 64, 64)
+            nvvm.tcgen05_wait(kind=nvvm.Tcgen05Wait.LOAD)
+        words = cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(fp32_to_fp16(vals[2 * i], vals[2 * i + 1], dtype=dtype) for i in range(32)), cutlass.Int32)
+        if cutlass.const_expr(half == 0):
+            _wait(bars.dq_empty[last_slice], empty_phase)
+        _store_words(slab, base + half * CFG.SLICE_BYTES, row, words)
+    nvvm.fence_proxy("async.shared", space="cta")
+    nvvm.tcgen05_fence(nvvm.Tcgen05Fence.BEFORE_THREAD_SYNC)
+    if cutlass.const_expr(dk):
+        bars.dk_full.arrive()
+    else:
+        bars.dv_full.arrive()
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _epilogue_loop(
+    slab,
+    bars,
+    sched,
+    tmem_base,
+    block,
+    head,
+    batch,
+    sq,
+    nk,
+    nheads,
+    batch_heads: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    swizzle: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    causal: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+    dtype: cutlass.Constexpr,
+):
+    nvvm.setmaxregister(CFG.EPILOGUE_REGS, nvvm.SetMaxRegisterAction.INCREASE)
+    row = cute.arch.thread_idx()[0] % CFG.M
+    ds_state = PipelineState.start()
+    dq_state = PipelineState.start()
+    empty_state = PipelineState.start()
+    sched_state = PipelineState.start()
+    valid = cutlass.Int32(1)
+    while valid != 0:
+        _credit(bars.sched_empty[sched_state.idx])
+        lo, hi = _bounds(block, sq, causal)
+        for qtile in cutlass.range(lo, hi, 1, unroll=1):
+            _wait_tcgen(bars.ds_ready, ds_state.phase)
+            ds0 = _tmem_load(tmem_base + 128, 32, cutlass.Int32)
+            ds1 = _tmem_load(tmem_base + 192, 32, cutlass.Int32)
+            nvvm.tcgen05_wait(kind=nvvm.Tcgen05Wait.LOAD)
+            _wait(bars.dq_empty[0], empty_state.phase)
+            _store_words(slab, CFG.ALIAS, row, ds0)
+            _wait(bars.dq_empty[1], empty_state.phase)
+            _store_words(slab, CFG.ALIAS + CFG.SLICE_BYTES, row, ds1)
+            nvvm.fence_proxy("async.shared", space="cta")
+            nvvm.tcgen05_fence(nvvm.Tcgen05Fence.BEFORE_THREAD_SYNC)
+            bars.ds_smem.arrive()
+            _wait_tcgen(bars.dq_done, dq_state.phase)
+            dq0 = _tmem_load(tmem_base + 128, 64)
+            dq1 = _tmem_load(tmem_base + 192, 64)
+            nvvm.tcgen05_wait(kind=nvvm.Tcgen05Wait.LOAD)
+            nvvm.tcgen05_fence(nvvm.Tcgen05Fence.BEFORE_THREAD_SYNC)
+            bars.dp_empty.arrive()
+            vals = cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(dq0[i] for i in range(64)) + tuple(dq1[i] for i in range(64)), cutlass.Float32)
+            for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+                _wait(bars.dq_empty[i], empty_state.phase)
+                _store_dq_slice(slab, row, vals, i)
+                nvvm.fence_proxy("async.shared", space="cta")
+                bars.dq_full[i].arrive()
+            ds_state = advance(ds_state, 1)
+            dq_state = advance(dq_state, 1)
+            empty_state = advance(empty_state, 1)
+        if lo >= hi:
+            _wait_tcgen(bars.dq_done, dq_state.phase)
+            dq_state = advance(dq_state, 1)
+        _native_epilogue(slab, tmem_base, bars, row, lo < hi, empty_state.phase, dtype, False)
+        _native_epilogue(slab, tmem_base, bars, row, lo < hi, empty_state.phase, dtype, True)
+        empty_state = advance(empty_state, 1)
+        block, head, batch, valid, sched_state = _next_tile(sched, bars, sched_state, nheads, nk, causal, swizzle, batch_heads)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _ts(desc, plane, bdesc, dst, accum):
+    for k in cutlass.range_constexpr(CFG.D // CFG.K_HW):
+        mma_ts_step(
+            desc, nvvm.make_tmem_ptr(plane + (k // 4) * 32, cutlass.Int8), bdesc, dst, k_idx=k, accumulate=accum if cutlass.const_expr(k == 0) else True
+        )
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _mma_loop(
+    slab,
+    bars,
+    sched,
+    tmem_base,
+    block,
+    head,
+    batch,
+    sq,
+    nk,
+    nheads,
+    batch_heads: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    swizzle: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    causal: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+    dtype: cutlass.Constexpr,
+):
+    nvvm.setmaxregister(CFG.SERVICE_REGS, nvvm.SetMaxRegisterAction.DECREASE)
+    score = _mma_desc(dtype)
+    grad = _mma_desc(dtype, btranspose=True)
+    dqdesc = _mma_desc(dtype, atranspose=True, btranspose=True)
+    kd = _operand(slab, CFG.K, dtype).desc()
+    vd = _operand(slab, CFG.V, dtype).desc()
+    dod = _operand(slab, CFG.DO, dtype).desc()
+    dot = _operand(slab, CFG.DO, dtype, transpose=True).desc()
+    dst = _operand(slab, CFG.ALIAS, dtype, transpose=True).desc()
+    kt = _operand(slab, CFG.K, dtype, transpose=True).desc()
+    s = nvvm.make_tmem_ptr(tmem_base, cutlass.Float32)
+    dp = nvvm.make_tmem_ptr(tmem_base + 128, cutlass.Float32)
+    dv = nvvm.make_tmem_ptr(tmem_base + 256, cutlass.Float32)
+    dk = nvvm.make_tmem_ptr(tmem_base + 384, cutlass.Float32)
+    q_state = PipelineState.start()
+    do_state = PipelineState.start()
+    kv_state = PipelineState.start()
+    ready_state = PipelineState.start()
+    dp_empty = PipelineState.start(phase=1)
+    out_empty = PipelineState.start(phase=1)
+    sched_state = PipelineState.start()
+    valid = cutlass.Int32(1)
+    while valid != 0:
+        _credit(bars.sched_empty[sched_state.idx])
+        lo, hi = _bounds(block, sq, causal)
+        if lo < hi:
+            _wait_tcgen(bars.k_full, kv_state.phase)
+            _wait_tcgen(bars.q_full[q_state.idx], q_state.phase)
+            qd = _operand(slab, CFG.Q + q_state.idx * CFG.OPERAND_BYTES, dtype).desc()
+            mma_ss(score, kd, qd, s)
+            _commit(bars.s_done)
+            _wait_tcgen(bars.v_full, kv_state.phase)
+        _wait_tcgen(bars.dvk_empty, out_empty.phase)
+        out_empty = advance(out_empty, 1)
+        for qtile in cutlass.range(lo, hi, 1, unroll=1):
+            _wait_tcgen(bars.dp_empty, dp_empty.phase)
+            _wait_tcgen(bars.do_full[0], do_state.phase)
+            mma_ss(score, vd, dod, dp, k_start=0, k_count=4)
+            _wait_tcgen(bars.do_full[1], do_state.phase)
+            mma_ss(score, vd, dod, dp, k_start=4, k_count=4, accumulate=True)
+            _commit(bars.dp_done)
+            _wait_tcgen(bars.p_ready, ready_state.phase)
+            _ts(grad, tmem_base, dot, dv, qtile > lo)
+            _commit(bars.do_empty)
+            q_next = advance(q_state, CFG.Q_STAGES)
+            if qtile + 1 < hi:
+                _wait_tcgen(bars.q_full[q_next.idx], q_next.phase)
+                qd_next = _operand(slab, CFG.Q + q_next.idx * CFG.OPERAND_BYTES, dtype).desc()
+                mma_ss(score, kd, qd_next, s)
+                _commit(bars.s_done)
+            _wait_tcgen(bars.ds_ready, ready_state.phase)
+            qt = _operand(slab, CFG.Q + q_state.idx * CFG.OPERAND_BYTES, dtype, transpose=True).desc()
+            _ts(grad, tmem_base + 128, qt, dk, qtile > lo)
+            _commit(bars.q_empty[q_state.idx])
+            _wait_tcgen(bars.ds_smem, ready_state.phase)
+            mma_ss(dqdesc, dst, kt, dp)
+            _commit(bars.dq_done)
+            q_state = q_next
+            do_state = advance(do_state, 1)
+            ready_state = advance(ready_state, 1)
+            dp_empty = advance(dp_empty, 1)
+        if lo < hi:
+            _commit(bars.k_empty)
+            _commit(bars.v_empty)
+            kv_state = advance(kv_state, 1)
+        else:
+            _commit(bars.dq_done)
+        block, head, batch, valid, sched_state = _next_tile(sched, bars, sched_state, nheads, nk, causal, swizzle, batch_heads)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _load_loop(
+    slab,
+    bars,
+    sched,
+    q_desc,
+    k_desc,
+    v_desc,
+    do_desc,
+    block,
+    head,
+    batch,
+    sq,
+    nk,
+    nheads,
+    batch_heads: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    swizzle: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    causal: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+    dtype: cutlass.Constexpr,
+):

+"""Native packed THD MHA d128 backward with FP32 dQ accumulation.
+
+Sequence-local tensor maps clip every input and output tail, including caller
+ports with independent ragged origins. The dense five-product pipeline and all
+33 mbarriers retain their lane counts. Natural CLC visits a declared envelope;
+invalid owners take the complete zero-trip protocol without touching a map.

+from typing import NamedTuple
+
+import cuda.bindings.driver as cuda
+import cutlass
+import cutlass.cute as cute
+from cutlass._mlir.dialects import arith
+from cutlass.base_dsl.typing import Pointer

+from cutlass.experimental.cuda import tensor_map as tmap
+
+from cudnn.frost.tile_dsl.barrier import MBarrier, PipelineState, Producer, advance, named_barrier_fence
+from cudnn.frost.tile_dsl.handles import MmaDesc, SmemTile, tma_slice_runtime_desc
+from cudnn.frost.tile_dsl.mask import apply_mask_words, band_mask_words
+from cudnn.frost.tile_dsl.thd import TENSOR_MAP_QWORDS, thd_port_origin

+    tma_load_subtiles,
+    tma_load_tile,
+    tma_reduce_add_subtile,
+    tma_store_commit,
+    tma_store_tile,
+    tma_store_wait,
+    tma_tensormap_acquire,
+)
+
+from ...config_sm100_d128_accum import BAR_LAYOUT, CFG
+
+LOG2E = 1.4426950408889634
+MAP_Q, MAP_K, MAP_V, MAP_DO, MAP_DQ, MAP_DK, MAP_DV = range(7)
+MAP_COUNT = 7
+
+
+class Bars(NamedTuple):
+    k_empty: MBarrier
+    k_full: MBarrier
+    v_empty: MBarrier
+    v_full: MBarrier
+    do_empty: MBarrier
+    do_full: MBarrier
+    q_empty: MBarrier
+    q_full: MBarrier
+    s_done: MBarrier
+    dp_done: MBarrier
+    dq_done: MBarrier
+    dp_empty: MBarrier
+    p_ready: MBarrier
+    ds_ready: MBarrier
+    ds_smem: MBarrier
+    dq_empty: MBarrier
+    dq_full: MBarrier
+    dv_full: MBarrier
+    dk_full: MBarrier
+    dvk_empty: MBarrier
+    sched_full: MBarrier

+
+def _view(slab, offset, dtype, count, alignment=16):
+    ptr = Pointer(slab.data_ptr() + offset, dtype=dtype)
+    return cutlass.Array(ptr.ir_value(), shape=count, dtype=dtype, alignment=alignment)
+
+
+def _bars(slab):
+    kinds = {"mma": Producer.MMA_COMMIT, "tma": Producer.TMA_LOAD, "thread": Producer.THREAD}
+    return Bars(
+        *(
+            MBarrier(_view(slab, off, cutlass.Int64, slots), stages=slots, init_count=count, producer=kinds[kind], try_wait=True)
+            for _, off, slots, count, kind in BAR_LAYOUT
+        )
+    )
+
+
+def _operand(slab, offset, dtype, *, transpose=False, fp32=False):
+    box = CFG.DQ_BOX if fp32 else CFG.HEAD_BOX
+    bpe = 4 if fp32 else CFG.BPE
+    return SmemTile(
+        base=_view(slab, offset, dtype, CFG.M * CFG.D, alignment=1024),
+        elems_per_stage=CFG.M * CFG.D,
+        leading_byte_offset=CFG.M * CFG.SWIZZLE_BYTES if transpose else 16,
+        stride_byte_offset=8 * CFG.SWIZZLE_BYTES,
+        layout=CFG.SWIZZLE_LAYOUT,
+        tma_loads_per_tile=CFG.D // box,
+        tma_granu_elems=box,
+        tma_subtile_stride_elems=CFG.M * box,
+        desc_version=CFG.DESC_VERSION,
+    )
+
+
+def _mma_desc(dtype, *, atranspose=False, btranspose=False):
+    return MmaDesc(
+        M=CFG.M,
+        N=CFG.N,
+        K=CFG.D,
+        bpe_a=CFG.BPE,
+        bpe_b=CFG.BPE,
+        tile_k_hw=CFG.K_HW,
+        atranspose=atranspose,
+        btranspose=btranspose,
+        cta_group=1,
+        idesc=nvvm.Tcgen05InstrDesc.build(
+            c_dtype=cutlass.Float32, a_dtype=dtype, b_dtype=dtype, m_dim=CFG.M, n_dim=CFG.N, a_major=int(atranspose), b_major=int(btranspose)
+        ),
+        kind=nvvm.Tcgen05MMAKind.F16,
+    )
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _wait(bar, phase):
+    bar.wait(phase)
+    # All full-warp consumers reconverge before any elected credit/issue.
+    nvvm.bar_warp_sync(cute.arch.FULL_MASK)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _wait_tcgen(bar, phase):
+    _wait(bar, phase)
+    nvvm.tcgen05_fence(nvvm.Tcgen05Fence.AFTER_THREAD_SYNC)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _commit(bar):
+    if nvvm.elect_sync():
+        bar.arrive(cta_group=1)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _credit(bar):
+    if nvvm.elect_sync():
+        bar.arrive()
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _tmem_load(address, n: cutlass.Constexpr[int], dtype: cutlass.Constexpr = cutlass.Float32):
+    return nvvm.tcgen05_ld("32x32b", nvvm.make_tmem_ptr(address, dtype), num=n)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _tmem_store(address, values):
+    nvvm.tcgen05_st("32x32b", nvvm.make_tmem_ptr(address, cutlass.Int32), values)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _map_ptr(maps, batch, n_batch, slot: cutlass.Constexpr[int]):
+    return (maps.iterator.raw_ptr() + (cutlass.Int64(slot) * n_batch + batch) * TENSOR_MAP_QWORDS).tospace(cutlass.AddressSpace.generic)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _next_tile(sched, bars, state):
+    _wait(bars.sched_full[state.idx], state.phase)
+    x, yz, valid = read_clc_payload(sched, state.idx * 8, warp_broadcast=True)
+    return x, yz & 0xFFFF, (yz >> 16) & 0xFFFF, valid, advance(state, CFG.SCHED_STAGES)
+
+
+def _tensor_map(tensor, box):
+    # Logical TMA coordinates (d, sequence, head, batch), source-proved order.
+    return tmap.create_tensor_map_tiled_from_view(tensor, box_dims=(1, CFG.M, 1, box), stride_order=(3, 1, 2, 0), swizzle=tmap.TensorMapSwizzle.s128b)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _bounds(block, meta, batch, n_batch, causal: cutlass.Constexpr[bool]):
+    data = cutlass.make_array_view(meta)
+    q_start = cutlass.Int32(data[n_batch + batch])
+    seq_q = cutlass.Int32(data[n_batch + batch + 1]) - q_start
+    seq_k = cutlass.Int32(data[batch])
+    lo = block if cutlass.const_expr(causal) else cutlass.Int32(0)
+    hi = (seq_q + CFG.N - 1) // CFG.N
+    if block * CFG.M >= seq_k:
+        lo = cutlass.Int32(0)
+        hi = cutlass.Int32(0)
+    return lo, hi, seq_q, seq_k, q_start
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _stats(slab, lse, delta, row, group, qbase, batch, head, scale, q_start, seq_q, origins, stats_origin: cutlass.Constexpr[int]):
+    # Full 256-lane named barriers also cover inactive tail rows. Invalid rows
+    # never dereference a Stats/Delta address, including an all-empty carrier.
+    named_barrier_fence(CFG.SOFTMAX_BARRIER, CFG.SOFTMAX_LANES)
+    local_row = qbase + row
+    if group == 0:
+        stat = cutlass.Float32(0.0)
+        if local_row < seq_q:
+            token = thd_port_origin(origins, stats_origin, batch, q_start) + cutlass.Int64(local_row)
+            if cutlass.const_expr(len(lse.shape) == 2):
+                val = cutlass.Float32(lse[token, head])
+            else:
+                val = cutlass.Float32(lse[0, head, token])
+            stat = -cutlass.Float32(LOG2E) * val
+            if val == cutlass.Float32(float("-inf")):
+                stat = cutlass.Float32(0.0)
+        _view(slab, CFG.STATS, cutlass.Float32, CFG.N).subview(row).store(stat)
+    else:
+        stat = cutlass.Float32(0.0)
+        if local_row < seq_q:
+            stat = -scale * cutlass.Float32(delta[0, head, cutlass.Int64(q_start) + local_row])

+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _p_values(slab, tmem_base, row, group, block, qtile, seq_q, seq_k, scale, causal: cutlass.Constexpr[bool], dtype: cutlass.Constexpr):
+    address = tmem_base + group * 64
+    a = _tmem_load(address, 32)
+    b = _tmem_load(address + 32, 32)
+    nvvm.tcgen05_wait(kind=nvvm.Tcgen05Wait.LOAD)
+    scores = cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(a[i] for i in range(32)) + tuple(b[i] for i in range(32)), cutlass.Float32)
+    values = []
+    scaled = scale * cutlass.Float32(LOG2E)
+    for chunk in cutlass.range_constexpr(16):
+        stat = _view(slab, CFG.STATS, cutlass.Float32, CFG.N).subview(group * 64 + chunk * 4).load(vector_size=4, alignment=16)
+        for pair in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+            i = chunk * 4 + pair * 2
+            e0, e1 = ffma2(scaled, scaled, scores[i], scores[i + 1], stat[pair * 2], stat[pair * 2 + 1])

+    # below the actual Q length, and entirely dead for a padded KV row. Select
+    # exact zero AFTER exp2 (also safe for a no-key row whose LSE is -inf).
+    key = block * CFG.M + row
+    qbase = qtile * CFG.N + group * 64
+    lo = key if cutlass.const_expr(causal) else None
+    hi = cutlass.Int32(arith.select((key < seq_k).ir_value(), seq_q.ir_value(), cutlass.Int32(0).ir_value()))
+    words = band_mask_words(lo, hi, qbase, 64)
+    p = apply_mask_words(cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(values), cutlass.Float32), words, mask_value=0.0, n_cols=64)
+    packed = cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(fp32_to_fp16(p[2 * i], p[2 * i + 1], dtype=dtype) for i in range(32)), cutlass.Int32)
+    _tmem_store(address, packed)
+    return p
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _ds_values(slab, tmem_base, group, p, scale, dtype: cutlass.Constexpr):
+    address = tmem_base + 128 + group * 64
+    a = _tmem_load(address, 32)
+    b = _tmem_load(address + 32, 32)
+    nvvm.tcgen05_wait(kind=nvvm.Tcgen05Wait.LOAD)
+    dp = cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(a[i] for i in range(32)) + tuple(b[i] for i in range(32)), cutlass.Float32)
+    packed = []
+    for chunk in cutlass.range_constexpr(16):
+        stat = _view(slab, CFG.DELTA, cutlass.Float32, CFG.N).subview(group * 64 + chunk * 4).load(vector_size=4, alignment=16)
+        for pair in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+            i = chunk * 4 + pair * 2
+            d0, d1 = ffma2(scale, scale, dp[i], dp[i + 1], stat[pair * 2], stat[pair * 2 + 1])
+            d0, d1 = fmul2(d0, d1, p[i], p[i + 1])
+            packed.append(fp32_to_fp16(d0, d1, dtype=dtype))
+    _tmem_store(address, cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(packed), cutlass.Int32))
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _softmax_loop(
+    slab,
+    bars,
+    sched,
+    tmem_base,
+    lse,
+    delta,
+    origins,
+    stats_origin: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    block,
+    head,
+    batch,
+    meta,
+    n_batch,

+    causal: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],

+            ds1 = _tmem_load(tmem_base + 192, 32, cutlass.Int32)
+            nvvm.tcgen05_wait(kind=nvvm.Tcgen05Wait.LOAD)
+            _wait(bars.dq_empty[0], empty_state.phase)
+            _store_words(slab, CFG.ALIAS, row, ds0)
+            _wait(bars.dq_empty[1], empty_state.phase)

+    while valid != 0:

+        if lo < hi:
+            _wait_tcgen(bars.k_full, kv_state.phase)
+            _wait_tcgen(bars.q_full[q_state.idx], q_state.phase)
+            qd = _operand(slab, CFG.Q + q_state.idx * CFG.OPERAND_BYTES, dtype).desc()
+            mma_ss(score, kd, qd, s)
+            _commit(bars.s_done)
+            _wait_tcgen(bars.v_full, kv_state.phase)
+        _wait_tcgen(bars.dvk_empty, out_empty.phase)
+        out_empty = advance(out_empty, 1)

+@cute.jit
+def _store_loop(
+    slab,
+    bars,
+    sched,
+    maps,
+    block,
+    head,
+    batch,
+    meta,
+    n_batch,
+    causal: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+    dtype: cutlass.Constexpr,
