+    nvvm.bar_warp_sync(cute.arch.FULL_MASK)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _read_stats_row(s_o, s_do, lse, batch, head, q_base, sq, rows: cutlass.Constexpr[int], row):
+    delta = cutlass.Float32(0.0)
+    for chunk in cutlass.range_constexpr(CFG.HEAD_DIM // CFG.HEAD_GRANULE):
+        off = chunk * rows * CFG.HEAD_GRANULE + row * CFG.HEAD_GRANULE
+        o_half = s_o.base.subview(off).data_ptr().load_swizzled(_SWIZZLE, alignment=128, count=CFG.HEAD_GRANULE)
+        do_half = s_do.base.subview(off).data_ptr().load_swizzled(_SWIZZLE, alignment=128, count=CFG.HEAD_GRANULE)
+        # Preserve the SW128 load and logical element order while expanding
+        # packed pairs directly, avoiding generic BF16 vector conversion.
+        o_words = o_half.bitcast(cutlass.Int32)
+        do_words = do_half.bitcast(cutlass.Int32)
+        o = cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(v for i in range(CFG.HEAD_GRANULE // 2) for v in f16x2_to_f32(o_words[i], dtype=o_half.dtype)), cutlass.Float32)
+        do = cutlass.Vector.from_elements(
+            tuple(v for i in range(CFG.HEAD_GRANULE // 2) for v in f16x2_to_f32(do_words[i], dtype=do_half.dtype)), cutlass.Float32
+        )
+        pair = row_reduction_pair(o * do)
+        delta += pair[0] + pair[1]
+    lse_val = cutlass.Float32(float("inf"))
+    if q_base + row < sq:
+        lse_val = lse[batch, head, q_base + row]
+    return lse_val, delta
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _write_stats(s_o, s_do, stats, lse, batch, head, q_base, sq, rows: cutlass.Constexpr[int]):
+    stats_thread = cute.arch.thread_idx()[0] - CFG.STATS_WARP * CFG.WARP_LANES
+    for row_group in cutlass.range_constexpr(rows // CFG.STATS_THREADS):
+        row = stats_thread + row_group * CFG.STATS_THREADS
+        lse_val, delta = _read_stats_row(s_o, s_do, lse, batch, head, q_base, sq, rows, row)
+        stats.subview(row).store(lse_val)
+        stats.subview(rows + row).store(delta)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _probability_masked(
+    s, dp, stats, owner_base, stream_base, sq, skv, scale, causal: cutlass.Constexpr[bool], q_owner: cutlass.Constexpr[bool], col: cutlass.Constexpr[int]
+):
+    tid = cute.arch.thread_idx()[0] % CFG.TILE_M
+    if cutlass.const_expr(q_owner):
+        lse = stats.subview(tid).load()
+        delta = stats.subview(CFG.Q_STATS_DELTA + tid).load()
+        hi = skv
+        if cutlass.const_expr(causal):
+            hi = cute.math.min(hi, owner_base + tid + 1)
+        live = (owner_base + tid < sq) & (lse != cutlass.Float32(float("-inf")))
+        hi = cutlass.Int32(arith.select(live.ir_value(), hi.ir_value(), stream_base.ir_value()))
+        words = band_mask_words(None, hi, stream_base + col, CFG.POINTWISE_COLS)
+        ds_live = skv > 1
+        if cutlass.const_expr(causal):
+            ds_live = ds_live & (owner_base + tid > 0)
+        ds_hi = cutlass.Int32(arith.select(ds_live.ir_value(), hi.ir_value(), stream_base.ir_value()))
+        ds_words = band_mask_words(None, ds_hi, stream_base + col, CFG.POINTWISE_COLS)
+    else:
+        lse = cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(stats.subview(col + i).load() for i in range(CFG.POINTWISE_COLS)), cutlass.Float32)
+        delta = cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(stats.subview(CFG.KV_STATS_DELTA + col + i).load() for i in range(CFG.POINTWISE_COLS)), cutlass.Float32)
+        lo = owner_base + tid if cutlass.const_expr(causal) else None
+        hi = cutlass.Int32(arith.select((owner_base + tid < skv).ir_value(), sq.ir_value(), stream_base.ir_value()))
+        words = band_mask_words(lo, hi, stream_base + col, CFG.POINTWISE_COLS)
+        ds_lo = cute.math.max(lo, cutlass.Int32(1)) if cutlass.const_expr(causal) else None
+        ds_hi = cutlass.Int32(arith.select((skv > 1).ir_value(), hi.ir_value(), stream_base.ir_value()))
+        ds_words = band_mask_words(ds_lo, ds_hi, stream_base + col, CFG.POINTWISE_COLS)
+    p = cute.math.exp2((s * scale - lse) * _LOG2E, fastmath=True)
+    p = apply_mask_words(p, words, mask_value=0.0, n_cols=CFG.POINTWISE_COLS)
+    # A row with exactly one legal key has softmax derivative exactly zero.
+    # Select zero rather than retaining dP-versus-delta reduction roundoff;
+    # P remains unchanged because that key still contributes to dV.
+    ds = apply_mask_words((dp - delta) * p * scale, ds_words, mask_value=0.0, n_cols=CFG.POINTWISE_COLS)
+    return p, ds
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _probability_full(s, dp, stats, scale, q_owner: cutlass.Constexpr[bool], col: cutlass.Constexpr[int]):
+    tid = cute.arch.thread_idx()[0] % CFG.TILE_M
+    if cutlass.const_expr(q_owner):
+        lse = stats.subview(tid).load()
+        delta = stats.subview(CFG.Q_STATS_DELTA + tid).load()
+    else:
+        lse = cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(stats.subview(col + i).load() for i in range(CFG.POINTWISE_COLS)), cutlass.Float32)
+        delta = cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(stats.subview(CFG.KV_STATS_DELTA + col + i).load() for i in range(CFG.POINTWISE_COLS)), cutlass.Float32)
+    # Full rectangles exclude SKV1 and causal query0, so both original
+    # masks are all-one. KV keeps its original nonfinite-LSE behavior.
+    p = cute.math.exp2((s * scale - lse) * _LOG2E, fastmath=True)
+    ds = (dp - delta) * p * scale
+    return p, ds
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _probability(
+    s, dp, stats, owner_base, stream_base, sq, skv, scale, causal: cutlass.Constexpr[bool], q_owner: cutlass.Constexpr[bool], col: cutlass.Constexpr[int]
+):
+    tid = cute.arch.thread_idx()[0] % CFG.TILE_M
+    if cutlass.const_expr(q_owner):
+        full = (owner_base + CFG.TILE_M <= sq) & (stream_base + CFG.TILE_N <= skv)
+        if cutlass.const_expr(causal):
+            full = full & (stream_base + CFG.TILE_N - 1 <= owner_base)
+        lse = stats.subview(tid).load()
+        # All32 lanes participate even on geometric tails. A sentinel in any
+        # lane sends that whole warp through the original zero-masking path.
+        lse_live = nvvm.vote_sync(cute.arch.FULL_MASK, lse != cutlass.Float32(float("-inf")), nvvm.VoteSync.ALL)
+        full = full & lse_live
+    else:
+        full = (owner_base + CFG.TILE_M <= skv) & (stream_base + CFG.TILE_N <= sq)
+        if cutlass.const_expr(causal):
+            full = full & (stream_base >= owner_base + CFG.TILE_M - 1)
+    # Seed staged-control-flow result types; both branches overwrite them.
+    p, ds = s, dp
+    if full:
+        p, ds = _probability_full(s, dp, stats, scale, q_owner, col)
+    else:
+        p, ds = _probability_masked(s, dp, stats, owner_base, stream_base, sq, skv, scale, causal, q_owner, col)
+    return p, ds
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _kv_full(owner_base, stream_base, sq, skv, causal: cutlass.Constexpr[bool]):
+    full = (owner_base + CFG.TILE_M <= skv) & (stream_base + CFG.TILE_N <= sq)
+    if cutlass.const_expr(causal):
+        full = full & (stream_base >= owner_base + CFG.TILE_M - 1)
+    return full
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _kv_probability_p(s, stats, owner_base, stream_base, sq, skv, scale, causal: cutlass.Constexpr[bool], col: cutlass.Constexpr[int]):
+    tid = cute.arch.thread_idx()[0] % CFG.TILE_M
+    lse = cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(stats.subview(col + i).load() for i in range(CFG.POINTWISE_COLS)), cutlass.Float32)
+    p = s
+    if _kv_full(owner_base, stream_base, sq, skv, causal):
+        p = cute.math.exp2((s * scale - lse) * _LOG2E, fastmath=True)
+    else:
+        lo = owner_base + tid if cutlass.const_expr(causal) else None
+        hi = cutlass.Int32(arith.select((owner_base + tid < skv).ir_value(), sq.ir_value(), stream_base.ir_value()))
+        words = band_mask_words(lo, hi, stream_base + col, CFG.POINTWISE_COLS)
+        p = cute.math.exp2((s * scale - lse) * _LOG2E, fastmath=True)
+        p = apply_mask_words(p, words, mask_value=0.0, n_cols=CFG.POINTWISE_COLS)
+    return p
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _kv_probability_ds(dp, p, stats, owner_base, stream_base, sq, skv, scale, causal: cutlass.Constexpr[bool], col: cutlass.Constexpr[int]):
+    tid = cute.arch.thread_idx()[0] % CFG.TILE_M
+    delta = cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(stats.subview(CFG.KV_STATS_DELTA + col + i).load() for i in range(CFG.POINTWISE_COLS)), cutlass.Float32)
+    ds = dp
+    if _kv_full(owner_base, stream_base, sq, skv, causal):
+        ds = (dp - delta) * p * scale
+    else:
+        lo = owner_base + tid if cutlass.const_expr(causal) else None
+        hi = cutlass.Int32(arith.select((owner_base + tid < skv).ir_value(), sq.ir_value(), stream_base.ir_value()))
+        ds_lo = cute.math.max(lo, cutlass.Int32(1)) if cutlass.const_expr(causal) else None
+        ds_hi = cutlass.Int32(arith.select((skv > 1).ir_value(), hi.ir_value(), stream_base.ir_value()))
+        ds_words = band_mask_words(ds_lo, ds_hi, stream_base + col, CFG.POINTWISE_COLS)
+        ds = apply_mask_words((dp - delta) * p * scale, ds_words, mask_value=0.0, n_cols=CFG.POINTWISE_COLS)
+    return ds
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _kv_p_chunk(
+    score_base, stats, owner_base, stream_base, sq, skv, scale, causal: cutlass.Constexpr[bool], dtype: cutlass.Constexpr, col: cutlass.Constexpr[int]
+):
+    s = tmem_load_tile(score_base + CFG.TMEM_S + col, num_elems=CFG.POINTWISE_COLS, ld_num=CFG.POINTWISE_COLS).vec
+    nvvm.tcgen05_wait(kind=nvvm.Tcgen05Wait.LOAD)
+    p = _kv_probability_p(s, stats, owner_base, stream_base, sq, skv, scale, causal, col)
+    packed_col = (col // CFG.GROUP_COLS) * CFG.GROUP_COLS + (col % CFG.GROUP_COLS) * CFG.BPE // CFG.TMEM_WORD_BYTES
+    nvvm.tcgen05_st("32x32b", nvvm.make_tmem_ptr(score_base + CFG.TMEM_S + packed_col, cutlass.Float32), p.to(dtype))
+    return p  # The original FP32 vector remains live; native conversion is a copy.
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _kv_ds_chunk(
+    score_base, p, stats, owner_base, stream_base, sq, skv, scale, causal: cutlass.Constexpr[bool], dtype: cutlass.Constexpr, col: cutlass.Constexpr[int]
+):
+    dp = tmem_load_tile(score_base + CFG.TMEM_DP + col, num_elems=CFG.POINTWISE_COLS, ld_num=CFG.POINTWISE_COLS).vec
+    nvvm.tcgen05_wait(kind=nvvm.Tcgen05Wait.LOAD)
+    ds = _kv_probability_ds(dp, p, stats, owner_base, stream_base, sq, skv, scale, causal, col)
+    packed_col = (col // CFG.GROUP_COLS) * CFG.GROUP_COLS + (col % CFG.GROUP_COLS) * CFG.BPE // CFG.TMEM_WORD_BYTES
+    nvvm.tcgen05_st("32x32b", nvvm.make_tmem_ptr(score_base + CFG.TMEM_DP + packed_col, cutlass.Float32), ds.to(dtype))
+

+def _q_ds(slab):
+    return _operand(slab, CFG.AUX, CFG.TILE_M, cols=CFG.TILE_N)

+@cute.jit
+def _mma_ts_gapped(desc, plane, desc_b, dest, accumulate):
+    for k in cutlass.range_constexpr(CFG.TILE_N // CFG.TILE_K_HW):
+        # mma_ts_step adds the packed K16 stride. Shift the origin past each
+        # group gap: logical group width minus its native packed width.
+        mma_ts_step(
+            desc,
+            nvvm.make_tmem_ptr(
+                plane + (k // (CFG.GROUP_COLS // CFG.TILE_K_HW)) * (CFG.GROUP_COLS - CFG.GROUP_COLS * CFG.BPE // CFG.TMEM_WORD_BYTES), cutlass.Int8
+            ),
+            desc_b,
+            dest,
+            k_idx=k,
+            accumulate=accumulate if cutlass.const_expr(k == 0) else True,
+        )

+@cute.jit
+def _issue_kv_s(slab, bars, tmem_base, input_state, full_state, dtype: cutlass.Constexpr):
+    _wait_service(bars.input_full, input_state)
+    nvvm.tcgen05_fence(nvvm.Tcgen05Fence.AFTER_THREAD_SYNC)
+    mma_ss(
+        _mma_desc(dtype),
+        _operand(slab, CFG.RESIDENT0, CFG.TILE_M).desc(),
+        _input(slab, input_state.idx, 0).desc(),
+        nvvm.make_tmem_ptr(tmem_base + CFG.TMEM_S, cutlass.Float32),
+    )
+    bars.s_full[full_state.idx].arrive(cta_group=CFG.CTA_MMA, pred=nvvm.elect_sync())
+    return advance(input_state, CFG.INPUT_STAGES), advance(full_state, CFG.SINGLE_STAGE)

+@cute.jit
+def _mma_kv(slab, bars, tmem_base, lo, hi, dtype: cutlass.Constexpr):
+    input_state = PipelineState.start()
+    input_empty_state = PipelineState.start()
+    s_state = PipelineState.start()
+    dp_state = PipelineState.start()
+    p_state = PipelineState.start()
+    ds_state = PipelineState.start()
+    score = _mma_desc(dtype)
+    grad = _mma_desc(dtype, gradient=True)
+    if hi > lo:
+        input_state, s_state = _issue_kv_s(slab, bars, tmem_base, input_state, s_state, dtype)
+    for tile in cutlass.range(lo, hi, 1, unroll=1):
+        mma_ss(
+            score,
+            _operand(slab, CFG.RESIDENT1, CFG.TILE_M).desc(),
+            _input(slab, input_empty_state.idx, 1).desc(),
+            nvvm.make_tmem_ptr(tmem_base + CFG.TMEM_DP, cutlass.Float32),
+        )
+        bars.dp_full[dp_state.idx].arrive(cta_group=CFG.CTA_MMA, pred=nvvm.elect_sync())
+        dp_state = advance(dp_state, CFG.SINGLE_STAGE)
+        _wait_service(bars.p_full, p_state)
+        nvvm.tcgen05_fence(nvvm.Tcgen05Fence.AFTER_THREAD_SYNC)
+        p_state = advance(p_state, CFG.SINGLE_STAGE)
+        _mma_ts_gapped(
+            grad,
+            tmem_base + CFG.TMEM_S,
+            _input(slab, input_empty_state.idx, 1, transposed=True).desc(),
+            nvvm.make_tmem_ptr(tmem_base + CFG.TMEM_G1, cutlass.Float32),
+            tile > lo,
+        )
+        if tile + 1 < hi:
+            input_state, s_state = _issue_kv_s(slab, bars, tmem_base, input_state, s_state, dtype)
+        _wait_service(bars.ds_full, ds_state)
+        nvvm.tcgen05_fence(nvvm.Tcgen05Fence.AFTER_THREAD_SYNC)
+        ds_state = advance(ds_state, CFG.SINGLE_STAGE)
+        _mma_ts_gapped(
+            grad,
+            tmem_base + CFG.TMEM_DP,
+            _input(slab, input_empty_state.idx, 0, transposed=True).desc(),
+            nvvm.make_tmem_ptr(tmem_base + CFG.TMEM_G0, cutlass.Float32),
+            tile > lo,
+        )
+        bars.input_empty[input_empty_state.idx].arrive(cta_group=CFG.CTA_MMA, pred=nvvm.elect_sync())
+        input_empty_state = advance(input_empty_state, CFG.INPUT_STAGES)
+    if hi > lo:
+        bars.final_grad.arrive(cta_group=CFG.CTA_MMA, pred=nvvm.elect_sync())
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _mma_q(slab, bars, tmem_base, lo, hi, dtype: cutlass.Constexpr):
+    input_state = PipelineState.start()
+    input_empty_state = PipelineState.start()
+    empty_state = PipelineState.start(phase=1)
+    s_state = PipelineState.start()
+    ds_state = PipelineState.start()
+    ds_empty_state = PipelineState.start()
+    score = _mma_desc(dtype)
+    grad = _mma_desc(dtype, gradient=True)
+    for tile in cutlass.range(lo, hi, 1, unroll=1):
+        _wait_service(bars.input_full, input_state)
+        _wait_service(bars.q_score_empty, empty_state)
+        nvvm.tcgen05_fence(nvvm.Tcgen05Fence.AFTER_THREAD_SYNC)
+        mma_ss(
+            score,
+            _operand(slab, CFG.RESIDENT0, CFG.TILE_M).desc(),
+            _input(slab, input_state.idx, 0).desc(),
+            nvvm.make_tmem_ptr(tmem_base + CFG.TMEM_S, cutlass.Float32),
+        )
+        mma_ss(
+            score,
+            _operand(slab, CFG.RESIDENT1, CFG.TILE_M).desc(),
+            _input(slab, input_state.idx, 1).desc(),
+            nvvm.make_tmem_ptr(tmem_base + CFG.TMEM_DP, cutlass.Float32),
+        )
+        bars.s_full[s_state.idx].arrive(cta_group=CFG.CTA_MMA, pred=nvvm.elect_sync())
+        input_state = advance(input_state, CFG.INPUT_STAGES)
+        empty_state = advance(empty_state, CFG.SINGLE_STAGE)
+        s_state = advance(s_state, CFG.SINGLE_STAGE)
+        _wait_service(bars.ds_full, ds_state)
+        nvvm.tcgen05_fence(nvvm.Tcgen05Fence.AFTER_THREAD_SYNC)
+        mma_ss(
+            grad,
+            _q_ds(slab).desc(),
+            _input(slab, input_empty_state.idx, 0, transposed=True).desc(),
+            nvvm.make_tmem_ptr(tmem_base + CFG.TMEM_G0, cutlass.Float32),
+            accumulate=tile > lo,
+        )
+        bars.input_empty[input_empty_state.idx].arrive(cta_group=CFG.CTA_MMA, pred=nvvm.elect_sync())
+        bars.q_ds_empty[ds_empty_state.idx].arrive(cta_group=CFG.CTA_MMA, pred=nvvm.elect_sync())
+        ds_state = advance(ds_state, CFG.SINGLE_STAGE)
+        input_empty_state = advance(input_empty_state, CFG.INPUT_STAGES)
+        ds_empty_state = advance(ds_empty_state, CFG.SINGLE_STAGE)
+    if hi > lo:
+        bars.final_grad.arrive(cta_group=CFG.CTA_MMA, pred=nvvm.elect_sync())
+    _wait_service(bars.q_score_empty, empty_state)
+    empty_state = advance(empty_state, CFG.SINGLE_STAGE)

+@cute.jit
+def _stage_gradient(tmem_base, tmem_offset: cutlass.Constexpr[int], smem, live, dtype: cutlass.Constexpr, group: cutlass.Constexpr[int]):
+    row = cute.arch.thread_idx()[0] % CFG.TILE_M
+    values = cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(cutlass.Float32(0.0) for _ in range(CFG.GROUP_COLS)), cutlass.Float32)
+    if live:
+        values = tmem_load_tile(tmem_base + tmem_offset + group * CFG.GROUP_COLS, num_elems=CFG.GROUP_COLS).vec
+        nvvm.tcgen05_wait(kind=nvvm.Tcgen05Wait.LOAD)
+    smem.base.subview(group * CFG.TILE_M * CFG.GROUP_COLS + row * CFG.GROUP_COLS).data_ptr().store_swizzled(values.to(dtype), alignment=128, swizzle=_SWIZZLE)

+@cute.jit
+def _compute_kv(
+    slab, stats, bars, tmem_base, owner_base, lo, hi, sq, skv, scale, causal: cutlass.Constexpr[bool], dtype: cutlass.Constexpr, group: cutlass.Constexpr[int]
+):
+    s_state = PipelineState.start()
+    dp_state = PipelineState.start()
+    stats_full_state = PipelineState.start()
+    stats_empty_state = PipelineState.start()
+    p_state = PipelineState.start()
+    ds_state = PipelineState.start()
+    for tile in cutlass.range(lo, hi, 1, unroll=1):
+        bars.s_full[s_state.idx].wait(s_state.phase)
+        bars.stats_full[stats_full_state.idx].wait(stats_full_state.phase)
+        nvvm.tcgen05_fence(nvvm.Tcgen05Fence.AFTER_THREAD_SYNC)
+        p0 = _kv_p_chunk(tmem_base, stats, owner_base, tile * CFG.TILE_N, sq, skv, scale, causal, dtype, group * CFG.GROUP_COLS)
+        p1 = _kv_p_chunk(tmem_base, stats, owner_base, tile * CFG.TILE_N, sq, skv, scale, causal, dtype, group * CFG.GROUP_COLS + CFG.POINTWISE_COLS)

+    for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(ELEMENTS_PER_LANE // 2):

+    dot = cute.math.add(dot, pairs[2], rounding=RN, ftz=True)
+    dot = cute.math.add(dot, pairs[3], rounding=RN, ftz=True)
+    for step in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+        peer = nvvm.shfl_sync(thread_mask=0xFFFFFFFF, val=dot, offset=1 << (3 - step), mask_and_clamp=0x1F, kind=nvvm.Shfl.BFLY)
+        dot = cute.math.add(dot, peer, rounding=RN, ftz=True)
+    dot = cute.math.mul(dot, dot_factor, rounding=RN, ftz=True)

+    tid, _, _ = cute.arch.thread_idx()
+    row = cutlass.Int64(block) * ROWS_PER_CTA + cutlass.Int64(tid // LANES_PER_ROW)
+    column = cutlass.Int64(tid % LANES_PER_ROW) * ELEMENTS_PER_LANE
+    src_offset = (
+        cutlass.Int64(batch) * cutlass.Int64(dq_accum.stride[0])
+        + row * cutlass.Int64(dq_accum.stride[1])
+        + cutlass.Int64(head) * cutlass.Int64(dq_accum.stride[2])
+        + column
+    )
+    dst_offset = (

+

+@cute.jit
+def cast_dq_host(dq_accum: cute.Tensor, dq_out: cute.Tensor, io_dtype: cutlass.Constexpr, stream: cuda_driver.CUstream):
+    """One native vector cast launch; output rows must be 16-byte aligned."""
+    cast_dq_d128_kernel(dq_accum, dq_out, io_dtype).launch(
+        grid=(dq_out.shape[1] // ROWS_PER_CTA, dq_out.shape[0], dq_out.shape[2]), block=(THREADS, 1, 1), stream=stream

+    ro_k_ptr: Optional[cute.Pointer],
+    ro_v_ptr: Optional[cute.Pointer],
+    ro_o_ptr: Optional[cute.Pointer],
+    ro_do_ptr: Optional[cute.Pointer],
+    ro_dq_ptr: Optional[cute.Pointer],
+    ro_dk_ptr: Optional[cute.Pointer],

+    origin_specs: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    causal: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],

+):

+    q, k, v = _io(q_ptr, t_q_phys, heads), _io(k_ptr, t_kv_phys, kv_heads), _io(v_ptr, t_kv_phys, kv_heads)
+    o, do = _io(o_ptr, t_q_phys, heads), _io(do_ptr, t_q_phys, heads)
+    dq, dk, dv = _io(dq_ptr, t_q_phys, heads), _io(dk_ptr, t_kv_phys, kv_heads), _io(dv_ptr, t_kv_phys, kv_heads)

+    ro = tuple(cute.make_tensor(ptr, cute.make_layout((batch + 1,), stride=(1,))) if cutlass.const_expr(ptr is not None) else None for ptr in ro_ptrs)

+        symbol="frost_sdpa_bwd_sm100_d128_grouped_thd_prepared",
+    )

+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright (c) 2026 NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES. All rights reserved.
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Storage-free plan construction for dense d128 backward."""
+
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+from cudnn.frost.compiled_cache import positional_entry
+from cudnn.sdpa.bwd.prepared import ATTRIBUTES, ROLES, BwdLaunchSpec, Operand
+from .d128_contract import ACCUMULATION, validate_launch, workspace_layout
+
+
+class _GuardedAccumulationEntry:
+    """Validate current pointer relationships before the first kernel launch."""
+
+    def __init__(self, entry, operands, workspace_bytes):
+        self.entry = entry
+        self.spans = tuple(op.span * op.itemsize for op in operands)
+        self.workspace_bytes = workspace_bytes
+
+    def __call__(self, q, k, v, o, do, lse, dq, dk, dv, workspace, scale, stream):
+        validate_launch((q, k, v, o, do, lse, dq, dk, dv), self.spans, workspace, self.workspace_bytes, scale)
+        self.entry(q, k, v, o, do, lse, dq, dk, dv, workspace, scale, stream)
+
+
+def compile_plan(api):
+    import cutlass
+    import torch
+
+    from cudnn.frost.device import compute_capability, resolve_device
+
+    geometry, operands = [], []
+    for role in ROLES[:9]:
+        desc = getattr(api, role + "_desc")
+        if role == "stats":
+            b, h, s, _ = desc.shape
+            shape, strides = (b, h, s), tuple(desc.stride[:3])
+            compact = (h * s, s, 1)
+            alignment = 4
+        else:
+            b, h, s, d = desc.shape
+            sb, sh, ss, sd = desc.stride
+            shape, strides = (b, s, h, d), (sb, ss, sh, sd)
+            compact = (s * h * d, h * d, d, 1)
+            alignment = 16
+        # Singleton pitches address no second element; normalize them for TMA.
+        strides = tuple(want if n == 1 else st for n, st, want in zip(shape, strides, compact))
+        geometry.append((shape, strides))
+        span = 1 + sum((int(n) - 1) * int(st) for n, st in zip(shape, strides))
+        operands.append(Operand(str(desc.dtype).split(".")[-1], shape, strides, span, alignment, desc.dtype.itemsize))
+    device = resolve_device(api.q_desc.device)
+    cc = compute_capability(device)
+    dtype = cutlass.BFloat16 if api.dtype == torch.bfloat16 else cutlass.Float16
+    regions, required = (), 0
+    if api._implementation == ACCUMULATION:
+        from .kernels.sm100.prepared_d128_accum_host import compile_host
+
+        regions, required = workspace_layout(api.batch_size, api.h_q, api.s_q_max)
+        compile_args = (tuple(geometry), regions, dtype, api.is_causal, cc[0] * 10 + cc[1])
+    else:
+        from .kernels.sm100.prepared_d128_host import compile_host
+
+        compile_args = (tuple(geometry), dtype, api.is_causal, cc[0] * 10 + cc[1])
+    # compile_cached owns device/context-aware reuse; no argument-only outer cache.
+    with torch.cuda.device(device):
+        entry = compile_host(*compile_args)
+    fn = positional_entry(entry)
+    if fn is None:
+        raise NotImplementedError("sdpa_bwd_sm100_d128 requires a positional tvm-ffi entry")
+    if required != api.scratch_workspace_bytes():
+        raise RuntimeError("dense d128 compiled workspace disagrees with its advertised size")
+    if api._implementation == ACCUMULATION:
+        fn = _GuardedAccumulationEntry(fn, operands, required)
+    return BwdLaunchSpec(
+        SimpleNamespace(entry=entry, workspace_bytes=required, workspace_regions=regions, implementation=api._implementation),
+        fn,
+        tuple(operands),
+        required,
+        device,
+        api.scale_softmax,
+        api._NAME,
+        roles=ROLES[:9],
+        attributes=ATTRIBUTES[:9],
+        scale_log2=False,
+        native_binding=True,
+    )

+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright (c) 2026 NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES. All rights reserved.
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Grouped d128 declarations: native dK/dV partials followed by an FP32 fold."""
+
+import re
+from functools import partial
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+from cudnn.frost.compiled_cache import positional_entry
+from .prepared import ATTRIBUTES, ROLES, BwdLaunchSpec, Operand, _same_geometry
+from .d128_contract import validate_accumulation_scale
+from .d128_grouped_contract import DENSE, THD, dense_workspace_layout, thd_workspace_layout, validate_dimensions, validate_dense_bounds, validate_thd_bounds
+from .d128_thd_contract import KV_PORTS, ORIGIN_PORTS, Q_PORTS, validate_stats_span
+from .prepared_sm100_d128 import _GuardedAccumulationEntry
+from .prepared_sm100_d128_thd import THD_ATTRIBUTES, THD_ROLES, _GuardedEntry
+
+
+def check_support(api):
+    """Grouped declarations only; MHA retains its original prepared routes."""
+    import torch
+
+    from cudnn import _pybind_module
+    from cudnn.frost.buffers import cutedsl_state
+    from cudnn.frost.device import compute_capability, resolve_device
+
+    def require(condition, reason):
+        if not condition:
+            raise NotImplementedError(f"{api._NAME}: grouped d128 {reason}")
+
+    installed, version = cutedsl_state()
+    match = re.match(r"^(\d+)\.(\d+)\.(\d+)", version[1]) if installed and version and version[0] == "nvidia-cutlass-dsl" else None
+    require(match is not None and tuple(map(int, match.groups())) >= (4, 8, 0), f"requires nvidia-cutlass-dsl >= 4.8.0; found {version}")
+    require(api.q_desc.device.type == "cuda", "Q must reside on CUDA")
+    cc = compute_capability(resolve_device(api.q_desc.device))
+    require(tuple(cc) == (10, 0), f"requires SM100; got {cc}")
+    require(getattr(getattr(_pybind_module, "_SdpaBwdBinder", None), "supports_zero_workspace", False), "requires prepared backward native binding support")
+    require(not api.seq_q_lens_present and not api.seq_kv_lens_present, "dense padding flags are not supported; THD lengths use packed metadata")
+    require(not api.causal_bottom_right, "bottom-right causal is not supported")
+    require(api.window_size_left is None and api.window_size_right is None, "sliding windows and right-band widening are not supported")
+    require(not api.deterministic, "use_deterministic_algorithm is not claimed")
+    require(all(d is None for d in (api.sink_desc, api.dsink_desc, api.bias_desc, api.dbias_desc)), "sink / dSink and bias / dBias are not supported")
+    require(api.tile_m is None and api.tile_n is None, "the kernel has fixed tile geometry")
+    for role in ROLES[:9]:
+        desc = getattr(api, role + "_desc")
+        require(desc.ndim == 4 and all(int(n) > 0 for n in desc.shape), f"{role} requires positive rank-four dimensions")
+        require(desc.device == api.q_desc.device, f"{role} must reside on {api.q_desc.device}")
+    b, h, sq, d = map(int, api.q_desc.shape)
+    bk, hk, sk, dk = map(int, api.k_desc.shape)
+    require(d == dk == 128, "D_QK and D_V must equal 128")
+    require(b == bk, "Q and KV must have equal batch counts")
+    try:
+        validate_dimensions(b, h, hk, sq, sk)
+    except ValueError as error:
+        require(False, str(error))
+    require(api.q_desc.dtype == torch.bfloat16, "supports BF16 grouped attention only; FP16 requires wider dK/dV partial storage")
+    for role in ROLES[:9]:
+        desc = getattr(api, role + "_desc")
+        s, heads = (sk, hk) if role in KV_PORTS else (sq, h)
+        expected = (b, heads, s, 1 if role == "stats" else 128)
+        require(tuple(desc.shape) == expected, f"{role} must have shape {expected}")
+        require(desc.dtype == (torch.float32 if role == "stats" else api.q_desc.dtype), f"{role} must match its declared storage dtype")
+    scale = 128**-0.5 if api.scale_softmax is None else float(api.scale_softmax)
+    try:
+        validate_accumulation_scale(scale)
+    except ValueError as error:
+        require(False, str(error))
+    api.batch_size, api.h_q, api.h_kv = b, h, hk
+    api.s_q_max, api.s_k_max = sq, sk
+    api.head_dim_qk = api.head_dim_v = 128
+    api.dtype, api.scale_softmax = api.q_desc.dtype, scale
+    if api.thd:
+        _check_thd(api, require)
+    else:
+        _check_dense(api, require)
+    api._is_supported = True
+    return True
+
+
+def _check_dense(api, require):
+    b, h, hk, sq, sk = api.batch_size, api.h_q, api.h_kv, api.s_q_max, api.s_k_max
+    require(not api._thd_ro_spec, "ragged offsets require THD")
+    try:
+        validate_dense_bounds(b, h, hk, sq, sk)
+    except ValueError as error:
+        require(False, str(error))
+    for role in ROLES[:9]:
+        desc = getattr(api, role + "_desc")
+        if role == "stats":
+            require(desc.is_contiguous(), "dense Stats must be contiguous")
+        else:
+            s, heads = (sk, hk) if role in KV_PORTS else (sq, h)
+            expected = (b, heads, s, 128), (s * heads * 128, 128, heads * 128, 1)
+            require(_same_geometry((desc.shape, desc.stride), expected), f"{role} requires compact BSHD storage")
+    api._grouped_workspace_regions, api._grouped_workspace_bytes = dense_workspace_layout(b, h, sq, sk)
+    api._implementation = DENSE
+
+
+def _check_thd(api, require):
+    import torch
+
+    from cudnn.sdpa.graph_analyzer import thd_stats_packing
+
+    b, h, hk, sq, sk = api.batch_size, api.h_q, api.h_kv, api.s_q_max, api.s_k_max
+    require(api.max_total_seq_len_q is not None and api.max_total_seq_len_kv is not None, "THD requires max_total_seq_len_q and max_total_seq_len_kv")
+    require(api.max_total_seq_len_q > 0 and api.max_total_seq_len_kv > 0, "THD declared packed capacities must be positive")
+    declared_q, declared_k = int(api.max_total_seq_len_q), int(api.max_total_seq_len_kv)
+    tq, tk = min(b * sq, declared_q), min(b * sk, declared_k)
+    ro_spec = api._thd_ro_spec
+    require(not set(ro_spec) - set(ORIGIN_PORTS), "ragged offsets name an unknown port")
+    tq_phys = declared_q if set(ro_spec) & Q_PORTS else tq
+    tk_phys = declared_k if set(ro_spec) & KV_PORTS else tk
+    try:
+        validate_thd_bounds(b, h, hk, sq, sk, tq, tk, tq_phys, tk_phys)
+    except ValueError as error:
+        require(False, str(error))
+    for role in ROLES[:9]:
+        if role == "stats":
+            continue
+        heads = hk if role in KV_PORTS else h
+        _, sh, ss, sd = map(int, getattr(api, role + "_desc").stride)
+        require(ss == heads * 128 and (heads == 1 or sh == 128) and sd == 1, f"{role} requires compact packed BSHD rows")
+    require(not (api.thd_stats_token_major and api.thd_stats_head_stride), "Stats head stride is head-major-only")
+    stats_stride = tuple(map(int, api.stats_desc.stride))
+    packing = thd_stats_packing(stats_stride[1], stats_stride[2], h)
+    expected = "token_major" if api.thd_stats_token_major else "head_major"
+    require(packing == expected or (h == 1 and stats_stride[2] == 1), "Stats strides disagree with the declared packed layout")
+    pitch = 0 if api.thd_stats_token_major else int(api.thd_stats_head_stride or stats_stride[1])
+    require(api.thd_stats_token_major or pitch >= tq_phys, "Stats head stride must cover the physical Q-token capacity")
+    require(api.thd_stats_token_major or h == 1 or pitch == stats_stride[1], "Stats head stride must match its declaration")
+    try:
+        validate_stats_span(h, tq_phys if api.thd_stats_token_major else pitch)
+    except ValueError as error:
+        require(False, str(error))
+    origin_specs, origin_dtypes = [], []
+    for row, port in enumerate(ORIGIN_PORTS):
+        if port not in ro_spec:
+            origin_specs.append(None)
+            origin_dtypes.append(None)
+            continue
+        item = ro_spec[port]
+        require(isinstance(item, (tuple, list)) and len(item) == 2, f"{port} offsets require (dtype, multiplier)")
+        dtype, multiplier = item
+        require(dtype in (torch.int32, torch.int64), f"{port} ragged offset must be INT32 or INT64")
+        require(type(multiplier) is int and 0 < multiplier <= 2**63 - 1, f"{port} ragged offset multiplier must be a positive Int64 integer")
+        heads = hk if port in KV_PORTS else h
+        token_stride = (h if api.thd_stats_token_major else 1) if port == "stats" else heads * 128
+        origin_specs.append((row, multiplier, token_stride))
+        origin_dtypes.append(str(dtype).split(".")[-1])
+    api._thd_t_q, api._thd_t_kv = tq, tk
+    api._thd_t_q_phys, api._thd_t_kv_phys = tq_phys, tk_phys
+    api._thd_head_pitch = pitch
+    api._thd_origins, api._thd_origin_dtypes = tuple(origin_specs), tuple(origin_dtypes)
+    api._grouped_workspace_regions, api._grouped_workspace_bytes = thd_workspace_layout(b, h, tq, tk)
+    api._implementation = THD
+
+
+def compile_plan(api):
+    import cutlass
+    import torch
+
+    from cudnn.frost.device import resolve_device
+
+    b, h, hk = api.batch_size, api.h_q, api.h_kv
+    geometry, operands = [], []
+    for role in ROLES[:9]:
+        desc = getattr(api, role + "_desc")
+        if api.thd:
+            if role == "stats":
+                shape, strides = (
+                    ((api._thd_t_q_phys, h), (h, 1))
+                    if api.thd_stats_token_major
+                    else ((1, h, api._thd_head_pitch), (h * api._thd_head_pitch, api._thd_head_pitch, 1))
+                )
+            else:
+                tokens, heads = (api._thd_t_kv_phys, hk) if role in KV_PORTS else (api._thd_t_q_phys, h)
+                shape, strides = (1, tokens, heads, 128), (tokens * heads * 128, heads * 128, 128, 1)
+        elif role == "stats":
+            shape, strides = tuple(desc.shape[:3]), tuple(desc.stride[:3])
+            compact = (h * api.s_q_max, api.s_q_max, 1)
+            strides = tuple(want if n == 1 else st for n, st, want in zip(shape, strides, compact))
+        else:
+            shape = tuple(desc.shape[i] for i in (0, 2, 1, 3))
+            strides = tuple(desc.stride[i] for i in (0, 2, 1, 3))
+            _, s, heads, d = shape
+            compact = (s * heads * d, heads * d, d, 1)
+            strides = tuple(want if n == 1 else st for n, st, want in zip(shape, strides, compact))
+        span = 1 + sum((int(n) - 1) * int(st) for n, st in zip(shape, strides))
+        if span * desc.dtype.itemsize > 2**63 - 1:
+            raise NotImplementedError(f"{api._NAME}: grouped {role} exceeds the signed pointer range")
+        geometry.append((shape, strides))
+        operands.append(Operand(str(desc.dtype).split(".")[-1], shape, strides, span, 4 if role == "stats" else 16, desc.dtype.itemsize))
+    dtype = cutlass.BFloat16 if api.dtype == torch.bfloat16 else cutlass.Float16
+    device = resolve_device(api.q_desc.device)
+    regions, required = api._grouped_workspace_regions, api._grouped_workspace_bytes
+    if required != api.scratch_workspace_bytes():
+        raise RuntimeError("grouped d128 compiled workspace disagrees with its advertised size")
+    if api.thd:
+        from .kernels.sm100.prepared_d128_grouped_thd_host import compile_host
+
+        operands.extend(Operand("int32", (b,), (1,), b, 4, 4, (b, b + 1)) for _ in range(2))
+        for name in api._thd_origin_dtypes:
+            width = 8 if name == "int64" else 4
+            operands.append(None if name is None else Operand(name, (b + 1,), (1,), b + 1, width, width))
+        args = ((b, h, hk, bool(api.thd_stats_token_major)), api._thd_origins, api._thd_origin_dtypes, dtype, api.is_causal, 100)
+    else:
+        from .kernels.sm100.prepared_d128_grouped_host import compile_host
+
+        args = (tuple(geometry), regions, dtype, api.is_causal, 100)
+    with torch.cuda.device(device):
+        entry = compile_host(*args)
+    fn = positional_entry(entry)
+    if fn is None:
+        raise NotImplementedError("grouped d128 requires a positional tvm-ffi entry")
+    if api.thd:
+        prefix = (api._thd_t_q, api._thd_t_kv, api._thd_t_q_phys, api._thd_t_kv_phys, api.s_q_max, api.s_k_max, api._thd_head_pitch)
+        fn = _GuardedEntry(partial(fn, *prefix), operands, required)
+    else:
+        fn = _GuardedAccumulationEntry(fn, operands, required)
+    owner = SimpleNamespace(
+        entry=entry, workspace_bytes=required, workspace_regions=regions, implementation=api._implementation, partial_dtype=str(api.dtype).split(".")[-1]
+    )
+    return BwdLaunchSpec(
+        owner,
+        fn,
+        tuple(operands),
+        required,
+        device,
+        api.scale_softmax,
+        api._NAME,
+        length_form=api.thd,
+        roles=THD_ROLES if api.thd else ROLES[:9],
+        attributes=THD_ATTRIBUTES if api.thd else ATTRIBUTES[:9],
+        scale_log2=False,

+    """Shared by graph and standalone; metadata cannot alias a gradient write."""

+    def __init__(self, entry, operands, workspace_bytes):

+    def __call__(self, *frame):

+"""Independent grouped references and guarded dense/THD d128 test storage.
+
+Only the CPU oracle expands KV heads. GPU carriers always have Hkv heads.
+The head-independent MHA poison, canary and numerical gates are reused intact.
+"""
+
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import torch
+
+from d128_thd_test_utils import CANARY, D, GRADS, Q_ROLES, ROLES, SCALE, check_case, copy_case_storage, make_workspace, poison as _poison
+
+
+def reference_sequences(lens_q, lens_kv, hq, hkv, dtype, causal, seed=149, inputs=None):
+    """CPU FP64 autograd sums shared KV gradients before any storage cast."""
+    assert hq > hkv > 0 and hq % hkv == 0
+    gen = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(seed)
+    head_map = torch.arange(hq) // (hq // hkv)
+    result = []
+    for i, (nq, nk) in enumerate(zip(lens_q, lens_kv, strict=True)):
+        if inputs is None:
+            draw = lambda n, h: (torch.randn(n, h, D, generator=gen) * 0.5).to(dtype)
+            q, k, v, do = draw(nq, hq), draw(nk, hkv), draw(nk, hkv), draw(nq, hq)
+        else:
+            q, k, v, do = (inputs[i][r].detach().cpu().to(dtype) for r in ("q", "k", "v", "do"))
+        assert q.shape == do.shape == (nq, hq, D) and k.shape == v.shape == (nk, hkv, D)
+        if nq == 0 or nk == 0:
+            o = torch.zeros_like(q)
+            stats = torch.full((nq, hq), float("-inf"), dtype=torch.float32)
+            dq, dk, dv = (torch.zeros_like(x, dtype=torch.float64) for x in (q, k, v))
+        else:
+            q64, k64, v64 = (x.transpose(0, 1).double().requires_grad_() for x in (q, k, v))
+            # index_select's backward sums gradients into ORIGINAL Hkv tensors.
+            scores = (q64 @ k64.index_select(0, head_map).transpose(-1, -2)) * SCALE
+            if causal:
+                scores = scores.masked_fill(torch.arange(nk)[None, :] > torch.arange(nq)[:, None], float("-inf"))
+            o64 = torch.softmax(scores, dim=-1) @ v64.index_select(0, head_map)
+            dq, dk, dv = (x.transpose(0, 1).detach() for x in torch.autograd.grad(o64, (q64, k64, v64), do.transpose(0, 1).double()))
+            o = o64.transpose(0, 1).detach().to(dtype)
+            stats = torch.logsumexp(scores.detach(), dim=-1).transpose(0, 1).float()
+        result.append(dict(q=q, k=k, v=v, o=o, do=do, stats=stats, dq=dq, dk=dk, dv=dv))
+    return result
+
+
+def cancellation_sequences(dtype, causal):
+    """Exact P=1 separates native partial rounding from FP32 fold arithmetic.
+
+    Even channels have group partials (large+0.5, -large, 1): rounding
+    individual partials produces 1 rather than the full-FP64 result 1.5.
+    Odd channels have (large, 1, -large): FP32 folding produces 1, while
+    sequential native-dtype addition loses the middle contribution. No
+    approximate softmax probability can confound this one-key fixture.
+    """
+    hq, hkv, nq, nk = 3, 1, 2, 1
+    large = 256.0 if dtype == torch.bfloat16 else 2048.0
+    inputs = {
+        "q": torch.zeros(nq, hq, D, dtype=dtype),
+        "k": torch.zeros(nk, hkv, D, dtype=dtype),
+        "v": torch.zeros(nk, hkv, D, dtype=dtype),
+        "do": torch.zeros(nq, hq, D, dtype=dtype),
+    }
+    inputs["do"][0, 0] = large
+    inputs["do"][1, 0, ::2] = 0.5
+    inputs["do"][0, 1, ::2] = -large
+    inputs["do"][0, 2, ::2] = 1.0
+    inputs["do"][0, 1, 1::2] = 1.0
+    inputs["do"][0, 2, 1::2] = -large
+    result = reference_sequences((nq,), (nk,), hq, hkv, dtype, causal, inputs=[inputs])
+    partials = inputs["do"].double().sum(0).to(dtype)
+    folded = torch.zeros((D,), dtype=torch.float32)
+    native_fold = torch.zeros((D,), dtype=dtype)
+    for partial in partials:
+        folded += partial.float()
+        native_fold += partial
+    assert torch.all(folded == 1)
+    assert torch.all(result[0]["dv"][0, 0, ::2] == 1.5)
+    assert torch.all(native_fold[1::2] == 0)
+    # The documented partial-storage semantics supersede a full-FP64 gradient
+    # target ONLY for this deliberately ill-conditioned cancellation fixture.
+    result[0]["dv"] = folded.to(dtype).double().view(nk, hkv, D)
+    return result
+
+
+def make_case(
+    lens_q,
+    lens_kv,
+    *,
+    hq=4,
+    hkv=2,
+    thd=True,
+    sequences=None,
+    dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+    causal=False,
+    stats_layout="TH1",
+    offset_dtype=torch.int64,
+    units="tokens",
+    gaps=True,
+    seed=149,
+    layout_shift=0,
+    envelope=None,
+    capacities=None,
+    origin_ports=None,
+    device="cuda",
+):
+    """Each port has independent origins, including a nonzero first origin.
+
+    The side's physical capacity includes every port's gaps, while the graph
+    envelope only describes sequence lengths. Guarded carriers expose their
+    full physical span; merely enlarging a backing allocation is insufficient.
+    """
+    lens_q, lens_kv = tuple(lens_q), tuple(lens_kv)
+    assert len(lens_q) == len(lens_kv) and len(lens_q) > 0
+    assert stats_layout in ("TH1", "HN") and units in ("elements", "tokens")
+    origin_ports = set(ROLES if origin_ports is None else origin_ports) if thd else set()
+    assert origin_ports <= set(ROLES)
+    envelope = envelope or (max(max(lens_q), 1), max(max(lens_kv), 1))
+    assert max(lens_q) <= envelope[0] and max(lens_kv) <= envelope[1]
+    if not thd:
+        assert len(set(lens_q)) == len(set(lens_kv)) == 1 and min(*lens_q, *lens_kv) > 0
+        assert envelope == (lens_q[0], lens_kv[0])
+    seqs = sequences or reference_sequences(lens_q, lens_kv, hq, hkv, dtype, causal, seed)
+    origins, ends = {}, {}
+    for index, role in enumerate(ROLES):
+        lens = lens_q if role in Q_ROLES else lens_kv
+        gapped = gaps and role in origin_ports
+        cursor = 1 + index + layout_shift if gapped else 0
+        starts = []
+        for batch, length in enumerate(lens):
+            starts.append(cursor)
+            cursor += length + ((index + 2 * batch) % 5 + 1 if gapped else 0)
+        origins[role], ends[role] = tuple(starts), cursor
+    cap_q = max(ends[r] for r in Q_ROLES) + 8
+    cap_kv = max(ends[r] for r in ROLES if r not in Q_ROLES) + 8
+    # Without an explicit origin on a side, its carrier is the compact prefix
+    # capacity min(B*Smax, declared total), including the positive empty case.
+    if not origin_ports.intersection(Q_ROLES):
+        cap_q = min(cap_q, len(lens_q) * envelope[0])
+    if not origin_ports.difference(Q_ROLES):
+        cap_kv = min(cap_kv, len(lens_kv) * envelope[1])
+    if capacities is not None:
+        assert capacities[0] >= cap_q and capacities[1] >= cap_kv
+        cap_q, cap_kv = capacities
+    assert origin_ports.intersection(Q_ROLES) or cap_q <= len(lens_q) * envelope[0]
+    assert origin_ports.difference(Q_ROLES) or cap_kv <= len(lens_kv) * envelope[1]
+    if not thd:
+        cap_q, cap_kv = sum(lens_q), sum(lens_kv)
+    # HN deliberately has unused columns at the end of every head slab.
+    head_pitch = ((cap_q + 63) // 64) * 64 + 16
+    tensors, raw, offsets, declarations, dead_rows = {}, {}, {}, {}, {}
+    for role in ROLES:
+        heads = hq if role in Q_ROLES else hkv
+        cap = cap_q if role in Q_ROLES else cap_kv
+        lens = lens_q if role in Q_ROLES else lens_kv
+        is_stats = role == "stats"
+        dt = torch.float32 if is_stats else dtype
+        shape = ((cap_q, heads) if stats_layout == "TH1" else (1, heads, head_pitch)) if is_stats else (1, cap, heads, D)
+        if is_stats and not thd:
+            shape = (len(lens_q), hq, lens_q[0], 1)
+        numel = 1
+        for n in shape:
+            numel *= n
+        # The nonzero carrier storage offset remains 16-byte aligned.
+        host_raw = torch.full((numel + 32,), CANARY, dtype=dt)
+        host = host_raw[16:-16].view(shape)
+        host.fill_(CANARY if role in GRADS else float("nan"))
+        live = torch.zeros(cap, dtype=torch.bool)
+        for i, (start, length) in enumerate(zip(origins[role], lens, strict=True)):
+            live[start : start + length] = True
+            if is_stats:
+                if not thd:
+                    host[i, :, :, 0].copy_(seqs[i][role].T)
+                elif stats_layout == "TH1":
+                    host[start : start + length].copy_(seqs[i][role])
+                else:
+                    host[0, :, start : start + length].copy_(seqs[i][role].T)
+            elif role not in GRADS:
+                host[0, start : start + length].copy_(seqs[i][role])
+            else:
+                host[0, start : start + length].fill_(float("nan"))
+        raw[role] = host_raw.to(device=device)
+        tensors[role] = raw[role][16:-16].view(shape)
+        dead_rows[role] = ~live
+        token_stride = (heads if stats_layout == "TH1" else 1) if is_stats else heads * D
+        values = (*origins[role], cap)
+        multiplier = token_stride if units == "tokens" else 1
+        if role in origin_ports:
+            offsets[role] = torch.tensor(values, dtype=offset_dtype, device=device) * (1 if units == "tokens" else token_stride)
+            declarations[role] = (offset_dtype, multiplier)
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        lens_q=lens_q,
+        lens_kv=lens_kv,
+        batch=len(lens_q),
+        heads=hq,
+        hq=hq,
+        hkv=hkv,
+        thd=thd,
+        dtype=dtype,
+        causal=causal,
+        stats_layout=stats_layout,
+        offset_dtype=offset_dtype,
+        units=units,
+        envelope=envelope,
+        capacities=(cap_q, cap_kv),
+        head_pitch=head_pitch,
+        origins=origins,
+        sequences=seqs,
+        tensors=tensors,
+        raw=raw,
+        offsets=offsets,
+        offset_declarations=declarations,
+        dead_rows=dead_rows,
+        lengths=(
+            {"seq_q": torch.tensor(lens_q, dtype=torch.int32, device=device), "seq_kv": torch.tensor(lens_kv, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)} if thd else {}
+        ),
+    )
+
+
+def declaration(case, role):
+    h, b = (case.hq if role in Q_ROLES else case.hkv), case.batch
+    s = case.envelope[0 if role in Q_ROLES else 1]
+    if role == "stats":
+        if not case.thd:
+            return (b, h, s, 1), (h * s, s, 1, 1)
+        stride = (case.capacities[0] * h, 1, h, 1) if case.stats_layout == "TH1" else (h * case.head_pitch, case.head_pitch, 1, 1)
+        return (b, h, s, 1), stride
+    return (b, h, s, D), (s * h * D, D, h * D, 1)
+
+
+def make_adapter(case, *, compile_plan=True):
+    from cudnn.api_base import TensorDesc
+    from cudnn.sdpa.bwd.api_dsl_sm100_d128 import SdpaBwdDslSm100D128
+
+    samples = {}
+    for role in ROLES:
+        shape, stride = declaration(case, role)
+        samples["sample_" + role] = TensorDesc(
+            dtype=torch.float32 if role == "stats" else case.dtype,
+            shape=shape,
+            stride=stride,
+            stride_order=tuple(sorted(range(4), key=lambda i: (stride[i], shape[i]))),
+            device=case.tensors["q"].device,
+            name=role,
+        )

+        **samples,
+        is_causal=case.causal,
+        scale_softmax=SCALE,
+        thd=case.thd,
+        max_total_seq_len_q=case.capacities[0] if case.thd else None,
+        max_total_seq_len_kv=case.capacities[1] if case.thd else None,
+        thd_stats_token_major=case.stats_layout == "TH1",
+        thd_stats_head_stride=case.head_pitch if case.stats_layout == "HN" else None,
+        thd_ragged_offsets=case.offset_declarations,
+    )
+    if not compile_plan:
+        return api
+    assert api.check_support()
+    api.compile()
+    assert api._prepared.native is not None
+    assert api._prepared.artifact.implementation == implementation(case)
+    return api
+
+
+def implementation(case):
+    return "accumulation_grouped_thd" if case.thd else "accumulation_grouped_dense"
+
+
+def bound_tensors(case):
+    if case.thd:
+        return case.tensors
+    # Make the public BHSD views during setup, never in the measured execute.
+    return {
+        r: t if r == "stats" else t.view(case.batch, case.envelope[0 if r in Q_ROLES else 1], case.hq if r in Q_ROLES else case.hkv, D).permute(0, 2, 1, 3)
+        for r, t in case.tensors.items()

+
+
+def adapter_arguments(case):
+    args = {r + "_tensor": t for r, t in bound_tensors(case).items()}
+    if case.thd:
+        args.update(seq_q_lens=case.lengths["seq_q"], seq_kv_lens=case.lengths["seq_kv"], thd_ragged_offsets=case.offsets)

+
+def make_graph(case):
+    import cudnn
+    from frost_test_utils import select_engine
+
+    io = cudnn.data_type.BFLOAT16 if case.dtype == torch.bfloat16 else cudnn.data_type.HALF
+    graph = cudnn.pygraph(io_data_type=io, intermediate_data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT, compute_data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT)
+    refs = {}
+
+    def attach_offsets(role, tensor):

+            return
+        dtype, mult = case.offset_declarations[role]
+        ro = graph.tensor(
+            name=role + "_ro",
+            dim=[case.batch + 1, 1, 1, 1],
+            stride=[1, 1, 1, 1],
+            data_type=cudnn.data_type.INT32 if dtype == torch.int32 else cudnn.data_type.INT64,
+        )
+        tensor.set_ragged_offset(ro)

+            tensor.set_ragged_offset_multiplier(mult)
+        refs[role + "_ro"] = ro
+
+    for role in ROLES[:6]:
+        shape, stride = declaration(case, role)
+        refs[role] = graph.tensor(name=role, dim=shape, stride=stride, data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT if role == "stats" else io)
+        attach_offsets(role, refs[role])
+    for role in case.lengths:
+        refs[role] = graph.tensor(name=role, dim=[case.batch, 1, 1, 1], stride=[1, 1, 1, 1], data_type=cudnn.data_type.INT32)
+    outs = graph.sdpa_backward(
+        name="d128_grouped_bwd",
+        q=refs["q"],
+        k=refs["k"],
+        v=refs["v"],
+        o=refs["o"],
+        dO=refs["do"],
+        stats=refs["stats"],
+        attn_scale=SCALE,
+        use_causal_mask=case.causal,
+        use_padding_mask=case.thd,
+        seq_len_q=refs.get("seq_q"),
+        seq_len_kv=refs.get("seq_kv"),
+        max_total_seq_len_q=case.capacities[0] if case.thd else None,
+        max_total_seq_len_kv=case.capacities[1] if case.thd else None,
+    )
+    for role, tensor in zip(GRADS, outs, strict=True):
+        shape, stride = declaration(case, role)
+        tensor.set_output(True).set_data_type(io).set_dim(shape).set_stride(stride)
+        refs[role] = tensor
+        attach_offsets(role, tensor)
+    graph.validate()
+    graph.build_operation_graph()
+    graph.create_execution_plans([cudnn.heur_mode.A])
+    select_engine(graph, "sdpa_bwd_sm100_d128")
+    engine, _ = graph.get_engine_and_knobs_at_index(graph._plan_index)
+    assert engine == 20609, engine
+    graph.check_support()
+    graph.build_plans()
+    spec = graph._compiled_plans[graph._plan_index]._prepared.spec
+    assert spec.native is not None
+    assert spec.artifact.implementation == implementation(case)
+    return graph, refs
+
+
+def variant_pack(case, refs):
+    return (
+        {refs[r]: t for r, t in bound_tensors(case).items()}
+        | {refs[r + "_ro"]: t for r, t in case.offsets.items()}
+        | {refs[r]: t for r, t in case.lengths.items()}
+    )
+
+
+def poison(case, workspace):
+    """Poison all declared scratch, including native dK/dV partial regions."""
+    _poison(case, workspace)
+    # All-one bits are NaN in FP32, BF16 and FP16. Missing a partial write must
+    # not be hidden by a small finite byte-pattern that falls below atol.
+    workspace.tensor.fill_(0xFF)

+ROLES = ("q", "k", "v", "o", "do", "stats", "dq", "dk", "dv")

+SCALE = D**-0.5

+def reference_sequences(lens_q, lens_kv, heads, dtype, causal, seed):

+
+    Inputs are rounded to the caller's storage dtype before the oracle sees
+    them. Empty attention has O=0/LSE=-inf and exactly zero gradients; it
+    never enters softmax. Nothing here knows the kernel's tile or scheduler.
+    """
+    gen = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(seed)
+    result = []
+    for nq, nk in zip(lens_q, lens_kv, strict=True):
+        draw = lambda n: (torch.randn(n, heads, D, generator=gen) * 0.5).to(dtype)
+        q, k, v, do = draw(nq), draw(nk), draw(nk), draw(nq)
+        if nq == 0 or nk == 0:
+            o = torch.zeros(nq, heads, D, dtype=dtype)
+            stats = torch.full((nq, heads), float("-inf"), dtype=torch.float32)
+            dq, dk, dv = (torch.zeros_like(x, dtype=torch.float64) for x in (q, k, v))
+        else:
+            q64, k64, v64 = (x.transpose(0, 1).double().requires_grad_() for x in (q, k, v))
+            scores = (q64 @ k64.transpose(-1, -2)) * SCALE

+    # capacity min(B*Smax, declared total), including the positive empty case.

+def _declarations(*, b=1, h=1, sq=128, sk=128, causal=False, scale=0.125):
+    from cudnn.api_base import TensorDesc
+    from cudnn.sdpa.bwd.api_dsl_sm100_d128 import SdpaBwdDslSm100D128
+
+    samples = {}
+    ports = []
+    for role in ("q", "k", "v", "o", "dO", "stats", "dQ", "dK", "dV"):
+        s = sk if role in ("k", "v", "dK", "dV") else sq
+        shape = (b, h, s, 1 if role == "stats" else 128)
+        stride = (h * s, s, 1, 1) if role == "stats" else (s * h * 128, 128, h * 128, 1)
+        samples["sample_" + role.lower()] = TensorDesc(
+            dtype=torch.float32 if role == "stats" else torch.bfloat16,
+            shape=shape,
+            stride=stride,
+            stride_order=TensorDesc._compute_stride_order(shape, stride),
+            device=torch.device("cuda", 0),
+            name=role,
+        )
+        if role != "stats":
+            ports.append((role, shape, stride))
+    facts = SdpaGraphFacts(
+        is_backward=True,
+        b=b,
+        h_q=h,
+        h_kv=h,
+        s_q=sq,

+        d_v=128,
+        dtype=cudnn.data_type.BFLOAT16,

+def _reason(facts):
+    spec = next(s for s in engines.ENGINE_SPECS if s.name == "sdpa_bwd_sm100_d128")

+def test_thd_mha_capture_rebind_lengths_origins_and_storage(layout, dtype, causal):
+    _require_accumulation()
+    options = dict(dtype=dtype, causal=causal, stats_layout=layout, envelope=(257, 257), capacities=(1024, 1024))
+    old = make_case((129, 0, 65), (3, 257, 0), **options)
+    graph, refs, pack, workspace = _graph_case(old)
+    fresh = make_case((1, 127, 0), (129, 0, 65), seed=151, layout_shift=7, **options)
+    changed = make_case((0, 193, 1), (17, 0, 129), seed=153, layout_shift=13, **options)
+    fresh_workspace = make_workspace(graph.get_workspace_size())
+    stream, ambient = torch.cuda.Stream(), torch.cuda.Stream()
+    handle = cudnn.create_handle()
+    capture = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+    cudnn.set_stream(handle, stream.cuda_stream)
+    try:
+        # Work follows the explicit handle stream even when another stream is
+        # current. All input producers precede it by an explicit dependency.
+        stable = None
+        for _ in range(10):
+            poison(old, workspace)
+            stream.wait_stream(torch.cuda.current_stream())
+            with torch.cuda.stream(ambient):
+                graph.execute(pack, workspace.tensor, handle=handle)
+            torch.cuda.current_stream().wait_stream(stream)
+            check_case(old, workspace)
+            stable = _stable_kv(old, stable)
+        stream.wait_stream(torch.cuda.current_stream())
+        with torch.cuda.graph(capture, stream=stream):
+            with torch.cuda.stream(ambient):
+                graph.execute(pack, workspace.tensor, handle=handle)
+
+        # Rebinding every pointer on the same plan must not retarget an earlier
+        # capture. This changes lengths, per-port origins and all data storage.
+        poison(fresh, fresh_workspace)
+        stream.wait_stream(torch.cuda.current_stream())
+        with torch.cuda.stream(ambient):
+            graph.execute(variant_pack(fresh, refs), fresh_workspace.tensor, handle=handle)
+        torch.cuda.current_stream().wait_stream(stream)
+        check_case(fresh, fresh_workspace)
+        snapshots = {role: fresh.tensors[role].clone() for role in GRADS}
+        copy_case_storage(old, changed)
+        stable = None
+        for _ in range(3):
+            poison(old, workspace)
+            capture.replay()
+            check_case(old, workspace)
+            stable = _stable_kv(old, stable)
+        for role in GRADS:
+            torch.testing.assert_close(fresh.tensors[role], snapshots[role], rtol=0, atol=0)
+    finally:
+        capture.reset()
+        cudnn.destroy_handle(handle)

+def test_thd_mha_four_launches_no_allocation_or_host_reads(dtype, causal, monkeypatch):
+    _require_accumulation()
+    import cutlass.cute as cute
+    from cudnn.sdpa.bwd import prepared
+
+    case = make_case((129, 0, 65), (3, 257, 0), dtype=dtype, causal=causal, stats_layout="HN")
+    graph, _, pack, workspace = _graph_case(case)
+    graph.execute(pack, workspace.tensor)
+    check_case(case, workspace)
+    torch.cuda.synchronize()
+    probe = case.lengths["seq_q"]
+    sync_mode = torch.cuda.get_sync_debug_mode()
+    torch.cuda.set_sync_debug_mode("error")
+    try:
+        with pytest.raises(RuntimeError):
+            probe[0].item()  # Prove the sync detector is armed.
+        before = torch.cuda.memory_stats()["allocation.all.allocated"]
+
+        def forbidden(*args, **kwargs):
+            raise AssertionError("prepared THD execution used Python tensor plumbing, allocation, host read or compilation")
+
+        with monkeypatch.context() as patch:
+            patch.setattr(cute, "compile", forbidden)
+            patch.setattr(prepared, "facts_of_roles", forbidden)
+            for name in ("empty", "empty_like", "zeros", "zeros_like", "ones", "full", "tensor"):
+                patch.setattr(torch, name, forbidden)
+            for name in ("view", "reshape", "as_strided", "permute", "transpose", "cpu", "item", "tolist"):
+                patch.setattr(torch.Tensor, name, forbidden)
+            for _ in range(3):
+                graph.execute(pack, workspace.tensor)
+        assert torch.cuda.memory_stats()["allocation.all.allocated"] == before
+    finally:
+        torch.cuda.set_sync_debug_mode(sync_mode)
+    torch.cuda.synchronize()
+    # The CUDA activity census also catches native D2H transfers missed by
+    # Python hooks. CPU synchronization emitted by profiler shutdown is outside
+    # the guarded execute region, so do not misclassify it as a kernel read.
+    with torch.profiler.profile(activities=[torch.profiler.ProfilerActivity.CPU, torch.profiler.ProfilerActivity.CUDA]) as prof:
+        graph.execute(pack, workspace.tensor)
+    names = [e.name for e in prof.events() if e.device_type == torch.autograd.DeviceType.CUDA]
+    assert names, "CUDA profiler activity is required for the launch/D2H gate"
+    assert not any("dtoh" in name.lower() or "device to host" in name.lower() for name in names), names
+    assert len(names) == 4, names
+    assert "bprop_d128" in names[2], names
+    check_case(case, workspace)

+PARTIAL_ITEMSIZE = 2  # BF16 for BF16 IO, FP16 for FP16 IO; final group accumulation is FP32.
+
+
+def validate_dimensions(batch, heads, kv_heads, sq, skv):
+    """Shared declaration-only launch checks for the adapter and row matcher."""
+    if any(type(n) is not int or n <= 0 for n in (batch, heads, kv_heads, sq, skv)):
+        raise ValueError("grouped dimensions must be positive integers")
+    if heads <= kv_heads or heads % kv_heads:
+        raise ValueError("requires Hq > Hkv and Hq divisible by Hkv")
+    if max(sq, skv) > 2**31 - 128:
+        raise ValueError("sequence envelope exceeds safe Int32 tile rounding")
+    if batch > 65535 or heads > 65535 or batch * heads * ((skv + 127) // 128) > 2**31 - 1:
+        raise ValueError("launch envelope exceeds the grid or Int32 work-id range")
+
+
+def validate_dense_bounds(batch, heads, kv_heads, sq, skv):
+    validate_dimensions(batch, heads, kv_heads, sq, skv)
+    if sq % 128 or skv % 128:
+        raise ValueError("dense sequence lengths must be multiples of 128")
+    # The shared fold computes bidx*256+tidx in Int32 before its widened
+    # element-address math. Aligned Skv makes this vector count block-aligned.
+    if batch * skv * kv_heads * 16 > 2**31 - 1:
+        raise ValueError("dense KV reduction exceeds the Int32 vector index range")
+    if max(sq, skv) * heads * 128 * 2 >= 2**40:
+        raise ValueError("native BSHD byte stride exceeds the tensor-map stride range")
+    if sq * heads * 128 * 4 >= 2**40:
+        raise ValueError("FP32 dQ byte stride exceeds the tensor-map stride range")
